roadmap.title: Mines: first descent and escape
roadmap.description: Descend the Mines on floors 1-5, learn the basics, and escape to the Swamp. Includes the secret Gnomish Mines.

roadmap.title: Swamp: floors 6-10 and its secret levels
roadmap.description: Clear and escape the Swamp, and loot the secret Jungle Temple and Haunted Castle.

roadmap.title: Sand Labyrinth: floors 11-15
roadmap.description: Survive the Sand Labyrinth, escape it, and complete Sokoban and the Minotaur Maze.

roadmap.title: Ruins and Baron Herx: floors 16-20
roadmap.description: Push through the Ruins to Baron Herx's lair, place the Mystic Orbs, and defeat him.

roadmap.title: Underworld, Hell and Baphomet: floors 21-24
roadmap.description: Descend through the Underworld and Hell, and defeat Baphomet.

roadmap.title: Crystal Caves: floors 25-30
roadmap.description: Explore the Crystal Caves, escape them, and clear the Cockatrice's Lair.

roadmap.title: The Citadel and the Sanctum: floors 31-35
roadmap.description: Reach the Citadel, clear Bram's Castle, and defeat the final boss in the Sanctum.

roadmap.title: DLC class and race runs
roadmap.description: Play every DLC class and race, escape with each, and unlock their kit-specific achievements.

roadmap.title: Co-op, NPC and challenge runs
roadmap.description: Multiplayer and NPC-support achievements plus the special win conditions (conducts, speed, Hardcore, and Brawler).

roadmap.title: Cross-run grinds, Hall of Trials and events
roadmap.description: Long-term cumulative counters, the Hall of Trials, seed events, and misc system achievements.

achievements.description: Descend to level 1 of the dungeon.
achievements.summary: Reach dungeon level 1 by descending through the hatch at the dungeon entrance.

steps.text: Cross the drawbridge, then pull the lever at the right of the entrance to raise the front gate, and take the hatch down to floor 1.

achievements.description: Escape the mines.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines by reaching dungeon floor 5.

guide.context: Floor 5 is a transition level: a safe area with two chests and the ladder to the next section. No standard enemies spawn there, but the chests can be Mimics.

steps.text: Descend from floor 1 to floor 5 of the @loc{Mines} and take the exit ladder.

achievements.description: Escape the swamp.
achievements.summary: Escape the Swamp by reaching dungeon floor 10.

guide.context: The Swamp introduces water, which slows movement, and its open rooms favor ranged enemies.

steps.text: Descend from floor 6 to floor 10 of the @loc{Swamp} and take the exit ladder.

achievements.description: Escape the sand labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Escape the Sand Labyrinth by reaching dungeon floor 15.

guide.context: The Sand Labyrinth is a maze-like tomb with @enemy{Scorpions} that can paralyze and @enemy{Scarabs} that can weaken.

steps.text: Descend from floor 11 to floor 15 of the @loc{Sand Labyrinth} and take the exit ladder.

achievements.description: Find and defeat Baron Herx in his lair.
achievements.summary: Find and defeat Baron Herx in Herx's Lair on dungeon floor 20.

guide.context: @enemy{Baron Herx} is a lich who casts @mechanic{Lightning} and raises minions as his health drops; he waits in Herx's Lair on floor 20.

steps.text: Reach Herx's Lair on floor 20 and defeat @enemy{Baron Herx}.

achievements.description: Find and read all of the books.
achievements.summary: Read every readable book in the game.

guide.context: Books appear as random loot, and the starting area always holds a copy of My Journal, so check Minehead before you descend. The game records each title you finish in scores.json, so that counter shows what is still missing.

steps.text: Pick up and read every readable book you find during your runs.

achievements.description: Survive instant death with an amulet of life saving.
achievements.summary: Survive a lethal blow while equipped with an Amulet of Life Saving.

steps.text: Equip an @item{Amulet of Life Saving}, then take a hit that would kill your character.

achievements.description: Find King Arthur's mystical sword, Dyrnwyn.
achievements.summary: Find Dyrnwyn, the legendary sword of King Arthur.

guide.context: @enemy{Shelob} and @npc{King Arthur} are Champion variants that rarely replace a normal spider or human, so this may take several runs to find.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Dyrnwyn} from Shelob in the Mines or Swamp, or from the Human champion King Arthur.

achievements.description: Find the mystical talking mace, Sharur.
achievements.summary: Find Sharur, the talking mace.

guide.context: The @enemy{Potato King} is a Champion Goblin that rarely replaces a normal Goblin, and @npc{Anansi} is a Human champion replacement.

steps.text: Obtain @item{Sharur} from the Potato King in the Swamp, from Anansi, or by trading the @item{Blue Orb} to Hamlet's Mysterious Trader.

achievements.description: Find the mystical axe, Parashu.
achievements.summary: Find Parashu, the legendary axe.

guide.context: @enemy{Funny Bones} spawns only in the Mines and the Underworld, so farm those sections for a chance at Parashu.

steps.text: Kill Funny Bones, a Champion Skeleton, and take @item{Parashu} from its drop.

achievements.description: Escape from the Gnomish Mines.
achievements.summary: Escape the Gnomish Mines, the secret area entered from dungeon floor 2.

guide.context: Two gates seal the floor 2 entrance at the end of a walkway that crosses a large pit; switches on either side open both gates.

steps.text: Find the secret entrance on floor 2, cross the walkway and activate both switches, then enter the @loc{Gnomish Mines} and take the exit ladder in the starting room.

achievements.description: Get crushed by a boulder.
achievements.summary: Die from being crushed by a rolling boulder.

guide.context: Boulder Traps are common in the Mines and release when you step on the wrong tile.

steps.text: Trigger a @mechanic{Boulder Trap} and stand in the boulder's path until it crushes you.
steps.note: This kills your character and ends the run.

achievements.description: Escape from the Minotaur Maze.
achievements.summary: Escape the Minotaur Maze, the secret area entered from dungeon floor 13.

guide.context: Teleportation is disabled inside the maze, and picking up the @item{Gold Key} or crossing the bridge spawns the @enemy{Minotaur} that chases you.

steps.text: Break into the sealed secret area on floor 13 with a @item{Pickaxe} or Dig, enter the Minotaur Maze, and reach its exit.

achievements.description: Start at least one game with every class.
achievements.summary: Start at least one run with every class in the game.

guide.context: A class is credited as soon as its run begins, so every attempt can end right after you enter floor 1.

steps.text: Create a character with each class and enter the dungeon once per class.

achievements.description: Find Odin's legendary spear, Gungnir.
achievements.summary: Find Gungnir, the legendary spear of Odin.

guide.context: Gates block the center chamber and pits ring three of its sides; use the Gold Key from the maze entrance, or bring Levitation and Opening. Gungnir also drops from the Human champion @npc{Vishpala}.

steps.text: Enter the Minotaur Maze from floor 13 and take @item{Gungnir} from the gated chamber at its center.

achievements.description: Find and defeat Baphomet.
achievements.summary: Find and defeat Baphomet in Baphomet's Domain on dungeon floor 24.

guide.context: The route runs through the second Underworld portal on Ruins floor 18 into Hell; the Underworld's pits need Levitation or the @mechanic{Obelisk} teleports.

steps.text: Reach Ruins floor 18, take the second Underworld portal, descend through Hell to the Molten Throne on floor 24, and defeat @enemy{Baphomet}.

achievements.description: Win the game with at least two players alive.
achievements.summary: Win the game with two or more players still alive.

guide.context: Only surviving players count toward the total, so a downed teammate still leaves you short.

steps.text: In a multiplayer game, keep at least two player characters alive through the @loc{Sanctum} boss fight on floor 35 and win.

achievements.description: Win the game without collecting any gold.
achievements.summary: Win the game without ever picking up gold.

guide.context: Killing shopkeepers and taking their goods is allowed; collecting gold or selling items is what voids the run. Type /pennilessmode in chat to switch on penniless mode, which blocks accidental gold pickups.

steps.text: Complete a full run without collecting gold or selling items, then defeat the final boss.

achievements.description: Win the game without eating any food.
achievements.summary: Finish the game without eating any food.

guide.context: Turning Hunger off also removes passive health regeneration, so bring healing spells or another way to recover HP.

steps.text: Disable Hunger in the settings, then finish a full run without eating any food.

achievements.description: Defeat Baron Herx or Baphomet in 20 minutes or less.
achievements.summary: Defeat Baron Herx or Baphomet within 20 minutes of starting the run.

guide.context: Turn on the HUD clock first. Seeds and the Assist Shrine do not disable achievements, and fast classes such as Ninja or Wanderer help.

steps.text: Race from floor 1 to Herx's Lair on floor 20, or to Baphomet's Domain on floor 24, and kill the boss before the clock passes 20 minutes.

achievements.description: Unravel the mystery of Sokoban.
achievements.summary: Complete the Sokoban puzzle in the secret area entered from dungeon floor 11.

guide.context: Breaking two or more boulders stops the artifact reward from spawning, so finish the puzzle cleanly.

steps.text: Break into the sealed @loc{Sokoban} entrance on floor 11 and push all seventeen boulders into the pits in the arena corners.

achievements.description: Loot the Haunted Castle and escape with your life.
achievements.summary: Loot the Haunted Castle in the Swamp and escape through its exit portal.

guide.context: Taking the castle loot raises gravestones along the outer track; walking near them spawns @enemy{Enslaved Ghouls}, so plan an exit route.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Haunted Castle} from Swamp floor 8, take its loot, and leave through the exit portal on the outer track.

achievements.description: Discover the trap-infested Temple in the swamp.
achievements.summary: Discover the Temple, the trap-filled secret area entered from Swamp floor 7.

guide.context: A bottomless pit and a corridor lined with Boulder Traps block the way in.

steps.text: Open the secret portal on Swamp floor 7 and cross the bridge into the @loc{Temple}.

achievements.description: Obtain 10,000 gold.
achievements.summary: Hold 10,000 gold in your inventory.

guide.context: Trading skill raises sale prices, and buying out a shopkeeper before killing them recovers the spent gold.

steps.text: Loot gold and sell valuable items until your inventory holds 10,000 gold.

achievements.description: Convince at least three NPCs to follow you at once.
achievements.summary: Have at least three NPC followers in your party at the same time.

guide.context: Followers die easily in combat, and @loc{Hamlet} and @loc{Minetown} are full of recruitable Humans.

steps.text: Recruit NPCs with Leadership, or by throwing beer or a confusion potion at Humans, until three follow you at once.

achievements.description: Kill at least 3 shopkeepers in one game.
achievements.summary: Kill at least three shopkeepers in a single game.

guide.context: Shopkeepers cast @mechanic{Magic Missile} innately, so they are dangerous at range.

steps.text: Kill three different shopkeepers during one game, using ranged weapons or the door-frame method to stay safe.

achievements.description: Kill at least 10 humans in a single game.
achievements.summary: Kill at least ten Humans in a single game.

guide.context: Humans are strong melee and magic fighters, and @loc{Minetown} and @loc{Hamlet} hold many of them.

steps.text: Kill every @npc{Human} you meet until ten have died in one game.

achievements.description: Win the game without having eaten any tins, meat, or fish.
achievements.summary: Finish a run without eating tins, meat, or fish.

guide.context: Skeletons do not need food at all, which makes them a safe pick for this run.

steps.text: Win a full run while eating only tomalley, bread, apples, cream pie, or cheese.

achievements.description: Win the game without having read any books, scrolls, or spellbooks.
achievements.summary: Finish a run without reading any book, scroll, or spellbook.

guide.context: This blocks scroll use and spell learning; skip mage classes and turn on Classic mode to shorten the run.

steps.text: Win a full run without reading any book, scroll, or spellbook.

achievements.description: Kill another player.
achievements.summary: Kill another player in a multiplayer game.

steps.text: In a multiplayer game, reduce another player character to zero health.

achievements.description: Reach the final stage in 45 minutes or less and win the game.
achievements.summary: Reach the Sanctum on dungeon floor 35 within 45 minutes and then win the game.

guide.context: The 45-minute limit applies only to reaching the Sanctum; the boss fight itself can run as long as needed.

steps.text: Race from floor 1 to the @loc{Sanctum} on floor 35 in under 45 minutes, then defeat @enemy{Orpheus} and @enemy{Erudyce}.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for ending the Archmagisters' plot in the Sanctum.
achievements.summary: Defeat the lich siblings Orpheus and Erudyce in the Sanctum on dungeon floor 35.

guide.context: Orpheus and Erudyce are the Act 2 final bosses and both are Undead; defeating both ends the game.

steps.text: Reach the Sanctum on floor 35, defeat Orpheus and Erudyce, then enter the portal that opens.

achievements.description: Exit Bram's Castle.
achievements.summary: Exit Bram's Castle, the secret area entered from Citadel floor 33.

guide.context: Followers cannot cross the castle's trapdoor ladders unless you command them with the interact command.

steps.text: Find the secret portal on Citadel floor 33, climb @loc{Bram's Castle}, defeat @enemy{Bram Kindly}, and take the portal that opens at the top.

achievements.description: Exit the Cockatrice's Lair.
achievements.summary: Exit the Cockatrice's Lair, the secret area entered from Crystal Caves floor 28.

guide.context: Dig, Opening, and Levitation fail inside the lair, so bring a Key or Lockpick for its locked chests.

steps.text: Find the secret portal on Crystal Caves floor 28, solve the lair's gate and ladder puzzles, defeat the @enemy{Cockatrice}, and take the portal that opens.

achievements.description: Attain victory in the Citadel by only attacking with your fists and throwing potions from the beginning of the game.
achievements.summary: Win the game attacking only with your fists and thrown potions.

guide.context: Brawler mode prevents actions that would void the run. Items, books, and scrolls are allowed, but casting learned spells is not.

steps.text: Type /brawlermode in chat to toggle brawler mode, then win the game attacking only with your fists and thrown potions.

achievements.description: Learn 20 Spells.
achievements.summary: Learn 20 different spells from spellbooks.

guide.context: Spell tiers need skill plus INT: None at 0-19, Basic at 20-39, Skilled at 40-59, Expert at 60-79, and Master at 80-99. The @npc{Scion} starts with 40 in all three schools.

steps.text: Read @item{spellbooks} until 20 different spells are learned; the @loc{Mystic Library} on floor 16 is full of them.

achievements.description: Kill a monster with a shuriken after it has twice bounced off a wall.
achievements.summary: Kill a monster using a shuriken that has ricocheted off two walls.

guide.context: Crystal shurikens are sold by most weapon merchants and found in chests; tight hallways make a double bounce easier.

steps.text: Weaken a monster in a narrow hallway and throw a @item{shuriken} so it bounces off two walls before hitting the monster.

achievements.description: Obtain and wear a full set of Artifact Armor.
achievements.summary: Wear all five pieces of Artifact Armor at the same time.

guide.context: Each piece comes from a different secret level. The Valkyries Veil sold by the Mysterious Trader is not required.

collectibles.name: Sphinx's Casque
collectibles.location: Gnomish Mines, lower-right room behind gates (secret entered from Mines floor 2)
collectibles.method: Open the gates with the lever in the mine's shop, or dig in with a Pickaxe, then take the casque.

collectibles.name: Oracle's Treads
collectibles.location: Haunted Castle, room left of the fireplace (secret entered from Swamp floor 8)
collectibles.method: Take the treads from the room beside the fireplace.

collectibles.name: Djinni's Brace
collectibles.location: Sokoban (secret entered from Sand Labyrinth floor 11)
collectibles.method: Complete the puzzle without breaking more than one boulder to spawn the brace.

collectibles.name: Dragon's Mail
collectibles.location: Cockatrice's Lair, small room between the first two crystal puzzles (secret entered from Crystal Caves floor 28)
collectibles.method: Open the room and take the breastplate.

collectibles.name: Wraith's Gown
collectibles.location: Bram's Castle, top floor (secret entered from Citadel floor 33)
collectibles.method: Defeat Bram Kindly and take the gown he drops.

achievements.description: Have 3 Mystic Orb effects active simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Have the Green, Red, and Blue Mystic Orb effects active at the same time.

guide.context: The Green Orb is on Swamp floor 7, the Red Orb on Sand Labyrinth floor 13, and the Blue Orb on Ruins floor 18; each needs a Gold Key from the same floor. The orbs cannot be placed once you enter Hell.

steps.text: Collect all three @item{Mystic Orbs} and set each one on its pedestal in Herx's Lair on floor 20.

achievements.description: Have 2 Dominated Crystal Golems under your leadership.
achievements.summary: Have two Crystal Golems under your control at the same time using Dominate.

guide.context: Dominate is a Mysticism Legend spell; the base limit is one dominated ally and rises by one for every 67% PWR above base.

steps.text: Cast @mechanic{Dominate} on two @enemy{Crystal Golems} in the Crystal Caves and keep both alive.

achievements.description: Kill a Minotaur after encountering Herx.
achievements.summary: Kill a Minotaur after encountering Baron Herx.

guide.context: Minotaurs keep appearing as random enemies after the Herx fight.

steps.text: Defeat or pass Baron Herx, then kill a @enemy{Minotaur} later in the run.

achievements.description: Hold a +10 Weapon.
achievements.summary: Hold a weapon enchanted to +10.

guide.context: Unequip everything except the weapon before using a fountain, which has a 7.5% chance to bless one item. Fist weapons cannot reach +10.

steps.text: Raise one weapon to +10 with Scrolls of Blessing, blank scrolls plus an Enchanted Feather, or a fountain, then keep it equipped.

achievements.description: Kill an ally player with a pushed boulder.
achievements.summary: Kill an allied player by pushing a boulder into them.

guide.context: A Barbarian's strength ring helps when pushing boulders.

steps.text: In a multiplayer game, push a @mechanic{boulder} into an allied player until it kills them.

achievements.description: Obtain 100,000 gold.
achievements.summary: Hold 100,000 gold in your inventory.

guide.context: The full 100,000 gold must be held in inventory. A Merchant with high Trading can sell anything to any shopkeeper.

steps.text: Sell gems and artifact gear, clear out shopkeepers' stock, then kill them to take back your gold until your inventory holds 100,000.

achievements.description: Finish the game from beginning to end with Classic and Hardcore modes on.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with both Classic mode and Hardcore mode enabled.

guide.context: A Classic run ends once Baron Herx is defeated. Playing Postmodern Hardcore does not also award this.

steps.text: Enable Classic and Hardcore in the settings, then finish a run from floor 1 through the Herx fight.

achievements.description: Finish the game from beginning to end with Hardcore mode on and Classic Mode off.
achievements.summary: Finish the full game with Hardcore mode enabled and Classic mode disabled.

guide.context: Leave Classic off and enable Hardcore; the run continues past Herx into the stronger Crystal Caves and Citadel.

steps.text: Finish the full game with Hardcore on and Classic off.

achievements.description: Successfully disarm 5 Automatons using Lockpicking.
achievements.summary: Disarm five Automatons using Lockpicking.

guide.context: Full-health Automatons appear from floor 26 in the Crystal Caves. The Rogue and Mechanist start with Tinkering points.

steps.text: Raise your @mechanic{Tinkering} skill, then attack five full-health @enemy{Automatons} from behind with a @item{Lockpick} to disarm each one.

achievements.description: Assassinate a Cockatrice.
achievements.summary: Kill a Cockatrice with a stealth attack.

guide.context: Cockatrices take 160% damage from swords but only 50% from ranged attacks and magic, so close in to backstab rather than shoot one down.

steps.text: Weaken a @enemy{Cockatrice}, get behind it while it faces away, and land a stealth attack for the kill.

achievements.description: Kill a Shadow who is mimicking your identity.
achievements.summary: Kill a Shadow after it has copied your appearance.

guide.context: Shadows appear in the Underworld, Hell, the Citadel, and Bram's Castle, and they are weak to magic.

steps.text: Let a @enemy{Shadow} copy your appearance, then kill it.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for getting the most out of a cursed Magicstaff.
achievements.summary: Break a cursed Magicstaff by using it until it degrades.

guide.context: Magic Staffs cast without using mana and ignore your skill level, so a spare cursed staff can be emptied quickly. The Gnomish Mines hold many Magicstaffs.

steps.text: Find a cursed @item{Magicstaff} and cast from it repeatedly until it breaks.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies while they are paralyzed or ensnared in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Kill ten enemies while they are paralyzed or caught in a snare in a single playthrough.

guide.context: A Brewer can produce paralysis and a Mechanist can build Beartraps.

steps.text: Use @item{Beartraps} or a paralysis effect such as @mechanic{Stoneblood}, then kill ten immobilized enemies in one playthrough.

achievements.description: Use a Mirror Shield to kill an enemy using its own reflected spell.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with its own spell after bouncing the spell back with a Mirror Shield.

guide.context: Enemy Spellbots are the easiest magic users to bait into casting at you.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Mirror Shield} and find a spellcasting enemy, such as an @enemy{Spellbot} in the Ruins.
Weaken the enemy until it is nearly dead, then hold the shield up in front of it.
Keep blocking until the enemy casts and the reflected spell kills it.

achievements.description: A hidden Barony achievement earned when a lich is slain by its own summoned servant.
achievements.summary: Make Baron Herx die to one of the minions he summons on Floor 20.

guide.context: Herx summons minions as he loses health and douses the arena once he drops below half health, which turns his minions on him.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Herx's Lair} on Floor 20 and damage him until he begins summoning minions.
Equip a @item{ring of Conflict}, keep the summoned minions alive, and let them attack Herx.
Stop attacking and let a minion land the final blow on Herx.

achievements.description: Throw a Healing or Extra Healing potion at another Player or allied NPC.
achievements.summary: Throw a potion of Healing or Extra Healing at another player or an allied NPC.

steps.text: Select a @item{potion of Healing} or @item{potion of Extra Healing} from the hotbar.
Throw it at another player or a recruited @npc{NPC} ally.

achievements.description: Dominate an NPC that is already allied to you.
achievements.summary: Cast Dominate on an NPC that is already your follower.

guide.context: Dominate is a high-tier Mysticism spell that normally turns an enemy into a follower.

steps.text: Recruit an @npc{NPC} as a follower by talking to it.
Learn @mechanic{Dominate} and cast it on the allied follower.

achievements.description: Kill a Scarab using a magic spell.
achievements.summary: Kill a Scarab with a magic spell.

guide.context: Scarabs resist most magic, so remove most of their health with a weapon before the finishing spell.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Scarab} in the @loc{Sand Labyrinth} and weaken it with a physical weapon.
Land the killing blow with any damaging @mechanic{magic spell}.

achievements.description: Eat Tomalley shortly after vomiting.
achievements.summary: Eat Tomalley soon after vomiting.

guide.context: Scarabs in the Sand Labyrinth drop Tomalley, and vomiting clears active food buffs.

steps.text: Get a @item{Tomalley} from a @enemy{Scarab} in the @loc{Sand Labyrinth}.
Eat too much food or eat rotten food until your character vomits.
Eat the Tomalley immediately after vomiting.

achievements.description: Eat 10 tins of food in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Eat 10 tins of food during a single run as a true Goatman.

guide.context: A true Goatman opens tins without a tin opener; other races must carry one to eat tins.

steps.text: Play as a true @mechanic{Goatman} and gather tinned food from shops and the dungeon.
Eat 10 tins before the run ends.

achievements.displayName: Don't Forget to Bring a Towel!
achievements.description: Use a towel to stop bleeding, clean pie off your face, and wipe grease from your hands.
achievements.summary: Use a towel to stop bleeding, wipe pie from your face, and clean grease off your hands.

guide.context: The three states are separate, so keep the towel for each use.

steps.text: Carry a @item{towel} and let an enemy wound you until you are bleeding, then use the towel.
Have another player throw a cream pie at your face, then use the towel to wipe the pie off.
Eat a tinned food item to become greasy, then use the towel to clean your hands.

achievements.description: Use a sink or fountain to extinguish flames.
achievements.summary: Put out burning by using a sink or fountain.

guide.context: You can set yourself on fire with a scroll of fire so the timing is under your control.

steps.text: Catch fire, then interact with a @loc{sink} or @loc{fountain} to douse the flames.
steps.note: A split-screen Automaton starts with a scroll of fire.

achievements.description: Throw booze at another character while you are under its effects.
achievements.summary: Throw booze at another character while drunk.

steps.text: Drink a @item{bottle of booze} and confirm the drunk effect is active.
Throw a second @item{bottle of booze} at another player or a recruited @npc{NPC}.

achievements.description: Gain extra Mana Regeneration from two sources simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Have two mana-regeneration bonuses active at the same time.

guide.context: Wearing the @item{Vampire Doublet} and the artefact cape @item{Wraith's Gown} together provides both sources.

steps.text: Get the @item{Vampire Doublet} from a @enemy{Vampire} and @item{Wraith's Gown} from @loc{Bram's Castle}.
Wear both items at once.

achievements.description: Gain extra Health Regeneration from two sources simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Have two health-regeneration bonuses active at the same time.

guide.context: A ring of regeneration and the artefact breastplate @item{Dragon's Mail} supply both sources.

steps.text: Get @item{Dragon's Mail} from the @loc{Cockatrice Lair}, and find a @item{ring of regeneration}.
Wear both items at once.

achievements.description: Destroy a boulder using a pickaxe while it's rolling toward you.
achievements.summary: Destroy a rolling boulder with a pickaxe before it hits you.

guide.context: A staff of digging reaches further than a pickaxe and buys extra reaction time.

steps.text: Trigger a @mechanic{boulder trap} and stand where the boulder will roll toward you.
Attack the rolling boulder with a @item{pickaxe} to shatter it.

achievements.description: A hidden Barony achievement earned by repeating the same self-immolating mistake.
achievements.summary: Read two scrolls of fire in one run.

guide.context: Reading a scroll of fire sets you alight, so keep a water source or a sink nearby.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{scroll of fire} from the dungeon, or from an @npc{Automaton} Mechanist in a split-screen game.
Read it, find a second scroll of fire, and read that one too.

achievements.description: Pick up an item that an Incubus or Succubus stole from you.
achievements.summary: Recover an item after an Incubus or Succubus has stolen it from you.

guide.context: These demons may appear from fountains and often teleport away after stealing, so a ring of warning makes the thief easier to find.

steps.text: Let an @enemy{Incubus} or @enemy{Succubus} steal one of your items.
Find and kill the thief, then pick the stolen item back up.

achievements.description: Perform a Block, Attack tradeoff 3 times against a single foe without taking an unblocked hit.
achievements.summary: Block and counterattack three times against one enemy without taking an unblocked hit.

guide.context: A shield or a torch both work as your blocking tool.

steps.text: Equip a @item{shield} or torch and single out one enemy.
Block its attack, hit it back at once, and repeat for three blocks and counters without being hit.

achievements.description: Have an allied player or NPC kill an enemy that you are Blocking.
achievements.summary: Block an enemy while an allied player or NPC kills it.

steps.text: Recruit an @npc{NPC} ally or team up with a second player.
Hold your shield in front of an enemy and keep blocking until your ally kills it.

achievements.description: Heal 1000 points of Player or Allied NPC hit points in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Restore 1000 points of health to players or allied NPCs in one run.

guide.context: Healing spells affect every nearby ally, so a @mechanic{Healer} with followers reaches the total quickly.

steps.text: Play a @mechanic{Healer} and recruit at least one @npc{NPC} follower.
Cast healing spells on yourself and your allies until the total restored reaches 1000 points.

achievements.description: Block and take no damage against a Cockatrice's melee attack.
achievements.summary: Block a Cockatrice's melee attack and take no damage.

guide.context: Cockatrices hit hard, so you need roughly 73 Armor Class, or a Monk's high Blocking skill, to absorb the blow without losing health.

steps.text: Raise your Armor Class to about 73, or play a @mechanic{Monk} for its high Blocking skill.
Hold your shield up and block a @enemy{Cockatrice}'s melee hit without losing any health.

achievements.description: A hidden Barony achievement earned by defacing a pony mural above the Floor 20 arena.
achievements.summary: Destroy the equine mural in Herx's Lair with a pickaxe.

guide.context: The mural sits on the upper wall of the arena, so you must fly up to it.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Herx's Lair} on Floor 20 and use @mechanic{levitation} to fly around the arena walls.
Find the equine mural on the right side and attack its face with a @item{pickaxe}.

achievements.description: Throw Sharur into a pit.
achievements.summary: Throw Sharur into a pit.

guide.context: Sharur is the talking mace dropped by the @enemy{Potato King} or @npc{Anansi}, or sold by the Mysterious Trader in Hamlet.

steps.text: Obtain the mace @item{Sharur}.
Open your inventory over a @loc{pit} and drop Sharur into the hole.

achievements.description: Give a Legendary item to an Allied NPC.
achievements.summary: Give an allied NPC or another player a Legendary item.

guide.context: The artefact helmet @item{Sphinx's Casque} in the Gnomish Mines is the quickest Legendary item to obtain.

steps.text: Get a Legendary item such as the @item{Sphinx's Casque}.
Drop it on the ground near a recruited @npc{NPC} and wait for it to pick the item up.

achievements.description: Die while equipped with a Legendary item.
achievements.summary: Die while wearing or wielding a Legendary item.

guide.context: The @item{Sphinx's Casque} from the Gnomish Mines is easy to reach early.

steps.text: Obtain a Legendary item such as the @item{Sphinx's Casque} and equip it.
Die while it is still equipped.

achievements.description: Defeat a powerful enemy with no more than 5 hit points remaining.
achievements.summary: Kill a powerful enemy with 5 or fewer hit points left.

guide.context: The lair @enemy{Cockatrice} is the easiest powerful enemy to set up, and you can lower your own health on purpose before the kill.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Cockatrice Lair} and bring the @enemy{Cockatrice} to one hit from death.
Lower your own health to 5 or fewer, then land the killing blow before it kills you.
steps.note: A @mechanic{Vampire} can use Bloodletting to reduce health safely.

achievements.description: Sacrifice your entire health pool to Dominate an enemy and survive it.
achievements.summary: Survive casting Dominate on an enemy whose health cost drains your whole health pool.

guide.context: Dominate spends 21 MP plus the target's current health, and only the spell (not the spellbook) counts; a full-health Cockatrice can consume over 500 HP, so wear an @item{amulet of life saving} to survive.

steps.text: Learn the @mechanic{Dominate} spell and equip an @item{amulet of life saving}.
With your health below 500, cast Dominate on a full-health @enemy{Cockatrice}.

achievements.description: Escape the Caves.
achievements.summary: Escape the Caves.

guide.context: The Caves sit on floors 26-30, and the exit ladder is on floor 30.

steps.text: Descend through the @loc{Crystal Caves} and take the exit on Floor 30.

achievements.description: Give an item to an Allied Automaton to recycle.
achievements.summary: Let an allied Automaton recycle an item you hand it.

guide.context: Automatons are neutral constructs found from the Ruins onward; make one your ally with @mechanic{Dominate}.

steps.text: Turn an @enemy{Automaton} into an ally, for example with @mechanic{Dominate}.
Drop an item on the ground beside the Automaton and wait for it to pick the item up.

achievements.displayName: I Am the One Who Knocks
achievements.description: Tank a minotaur's attack and take no damage from it without blocking.
achievements.summary: Take no damage from a Minotaur's attack without blocking.

guide.context: A @mechanic{Salamander} can enter stone form for about two seconds, which is enough to absorb the hit; a Minotaur can be found in the Mines.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Minotaur} in the @loc{Mines}, or in the Minotaur Maze.
As a @mechanic{Salamander}, activate stone form just as the Minotaur swings so the hit deals no damage.

achievements.description: Exploit the Light spell by casting it 20 times in a single minute.
achievements.summary: Cast the Light spell 20 times within one minute.

guide.context: Light is a cheap sustained Thaumaturgy spell that Monks and Wizards start with.

steps.text: Play a @mechanic{Monk} or @mechanic{Wizard} and learn the @mechanic{Light} spell.
Cast Light 20 times within 60 seconds.
steps.note: A staff of light also works and never fizzles.

achievements.description: Survive 150 damage or more taken from a single attack.
achievements.summary: Survive taking 150 or more damage from a single attack.

guide.context: You need above 150 maximum health, and removing armor lets more of a big hit through.

steps.text: Raise your maximum health above 150 and take off some armor.
Let a hard hitter such as a @enemy{Crystal Golem} land a heavy attack and survive it.

achievements.description: Return to Hamlet with a human NPC ally.
achievements.summary: Arrive in Hamlet with a human NPC ally.

guide.context: Recruit a human follower and keep it alive through the Ruins and the Baron Herx fight; the portal he opens leads to Hamlet on floor 25.

steps.text: Recruit a human @npc{NPC} follower and keep it alive through the @loc{Ruins} and the fight with Baron Herx.
Place Herx's Purple Mystic Orb on the pedestal and travel through the portal to @loc{Hamlet} with the ally still following.

achievements.description: Start a game with a Workshop or local mod file loaded.
achievements.summary: Begin a game while a Workshop or local mod is loaded.

guide.context: A local mod file works the same way, so a Workshop subscription is not required.

steps.text: Subscribe to a Workshop item and open the Workshop menu from the main menu.
Load the item, choose Start Modded Game, and begin a new game.

achievements.description: Launch the Barony level editor.
achievements.summary: Launch the Barony level editor.

guide.context: The editor is offered in the pop-up when Barony launches, or from the game's install folder.

steps.text: Start Barony and choose the level editor, or open the editor program in the game's install folder.

achievements.description: Catch an Insectoid or Goatman's flying thrown weapon.
achievements.summary: Catch a thrown weapon that an Insectoid or Goatman hurls at you.

guide.context: Goatmen will pick up a throwable you drop, but Crystal Caves Insectoids will not, so only their starting weapons can be caught there.

steps.text: Carry a throwable such as a @item{steel chakram} to a place where @enemy{Goatmen} appear, such as the Citadel.
Let a Goatman break its own weapon, then drop your chakram so it picks the chakram up.
Stand in its throw line and block as it throws to catch the weapon in mid-air.

achievements.description: Gain 50+ Levels of Swimming with Hunger turned off, as though there was a skill called Swimming.
achievements.summary: Gain 50 levels of the removed Swimming skill with Hunger turned off.

guide.context: Swimming no longer appears on the skill sheet, but standing in water still trains it, taking about seven minutes for 50 levels.

steps.text: Turn Hunger off in the settings.
Stand in water, such as a @loc{Swamp} pool, until the total reaches 50 levels.

achievements.description: Identify 50 pieces of Worthless Glass throughout multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Identify 50 pieces of Worthless Glass across all playthroughs.

guide.context: Only a high @mechanic{Lore} skill reveals Worthless Glass, and failed appraisals still train Lore.

steps.text: Raise the @mechanic{Lore} skill by appraising items, including failed attempts.
Identify every piece of Worthless Glass you find until 50 have been identified in total.

achievements.description: Have 50 enemies break their weapons against you throughout multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Get 50 enemies to shatter their weapons on you across all playthroughs.

guide.context: Holding a shield lets weak enemies wear down their own weapons.

steps.text: Equip a @item{shield} and let weak enemies attack you while you block.
Repeat until 50 enemy weapons have broken against you across playthroughs.

achievements.description: Break 50 pieces of enemy armor throughout multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Break 50 pieces of enemy armor across all playthroughs.

guide.context: Enemy armor only breaks while its wearer is taking damage, so use a weak weapon or bare hands to keep the enemy alive.

steps.text: Attack armored enemies, such as @enemy{Goblins}, with a weak weapon or unarmed strikes.
Repeat until 50 pieces of enemy armor have broken across playthroughs.

achievements.description: Perform a fatal stealth attack on an enemy that is attacking another player or allied NPC.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a stealth attack while it attacks another player or ally.

guide.context: A recruited NPC can act as bait so the enemy turns its back to you.

steps.text: Recruit an @npc{NPC} follower and let it draw a weak @enemy{enemy}'s attention.
Sneak behind the distracted enemy and land a fatal backstab.

achievements.description: Play a game with 3 or more players where everyone is a monster.
achievements.summary: Play a game with at least three players where every character is a monster.

guide.context: Any DLC monster race counts, such as Skeleton, Vampire, Succubus, Goatman, Automaton, Incubus, Goblin, or Insectoid.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{multiplayer} or split-screen game with three or more players.
Have every player pick a true monster race.

achievements.description: As a monster, trade 50,000 gold while under the effects of Polymorph across all your games.
achievements.summary: Trade a total of 50,000 gold as a monster while polymorphed across all games.

guide.context: Monsters must be in human form to trade, so keep a @item{Potion of Polymorph} active; the effect ends in water.

steps.text: Play a monster race and use a @item{Potion of Polymorph} to take human form.
Buy and sell with shopkeepers until 50,000 gold of trades is reached across your games.

achievements.description: Get chased out of a shop because you're a monster.
achievements.summary: Be driven out of a shop by a Shopkeeper because you are a monster.

guide.context: Shopkeepers refuse to serve monster races and will force you out; walk in as a true monster.

steps.text: Play a true monster race and enter a @loc{shop}.
Approach the @npc{Shopkeeper} until it chases you out of the room.

achievements.description: Recruit a human ally as a monster.
achievements.summary: Recruit a human ally while playing as a monster.

guide.context: Monsters cannot recruit humans by talking, so make the human drunk with thrown booze or hit it with a Confuse effect first.

steps.text: Play a true monster and find a @npc{human} NPC.
Make the human drunk with a thrown @item{bottle of booze}, or confuse it.
Recruit the impaired human as a follower.

achievements.description: A hidden Barony achievement for a skeleton that manages to eat.
achievements.summary: Eat a food item while playing as a true Skeleton.

steps.text: Play as a true @mechanic{Skeleton} and eat any food item.

achievements.description: Revive yourself by expending your mana as a skeleton.
achievements.summary: Revive yourself as a Skeleton by spending mana.

steps.text: Play as a true @mechanic{Skeleton} and keep at least 75 mana available.
Take fatal damage so the revive triggers.

achievements.description: Recruit four ghouls at once as a skeleton.
achievements.summary: Recruit four Ghouls at once while playing as a Skeleton.

guide.context: The @loc{Haunted Castle} in the Swamp is full of Ghouls.

steps.text: Play as a true @mechanic{Skeleton} and go to the @loc{Haunted Castle}.
Recruit four @enemy{Ghouls} so that all four follow you at the same time.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as a true Goatman of any class.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Goatman body, using any class.

guide.context: The Citadel covers floors 31-35 and the run ends in the Sanctum; stay a true Goatman rather than polymorphing.

steps.text: Start a run as a true @mechanic{Goatman}.
Finish the game by defeating the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as a true Vampire of any class.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Vampire body, using any class.

guide.context: A true Vampire must not be cured; water harms it, and the run ends in the Sanctum.

steps.text: Start a run as a true @mechanic{Vampire} and avoid the cure.
Finish the game by defeating the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as a true Succubus of any class.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Succubus body, using any class.

guide.context: The Citadel covers floors 31-35 and the run ends in the Sanctum; stay a true Succubus rather than polymorphing.

steps.text: Start a run as a true @mechanic{Succubus}.
Finish the game by defeating the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as a true Skeleton of any class.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Skeleton body, using any class.

guide.context: The Citadel covers floors 31-35 and the run ends in the Sanctum; stay a true Skeleton rather than polymorphing.

steps.text: Start a run as a true @mechanic{Skeleton}.
Finish the game by defeating the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as the Brewer class of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Brewer of any race.

guide.context: Brewer is the Goatman's signature class, though any race may select it. The run is recorded only after the bosses on floor 35 fall.

steps.text: Start a run as the @mechanic{Brewer} class.
Descend to floor 35 and defeat the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as the Conjurer class of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Conjurer of any race.

guide.context: Conjurer is the Skeleton's signature class, though any race may select it.

steps.text: Start a run as the @mechanic{Conjurer} class.
Descend to floor 35 and defeat the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as the Mesmer class of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Mesmer of any race.

guide.context: Mesmer is the Succubus's signature class, though any race may select it.

steps.text: Start a run as the @mechanic{Mesmer} class.
Descend to floor 35 and defeat the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel playing as the Accursed class of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as an Accursed of any race.

guide.context: Accursed is the Vampire's signature class, though any race may select it.

steps.text: Start a run as the @mechanic{Accursed} class.
Descend to floor 35 and defeat the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Eat food when polymorphed into a human as a true Skeleton.
achievements.summary: As a true Skeleton, eat food while a Polymorph effect has turned you into a human.

guide.context: A true Skeleton cannot digest ordinary food, and Polymorph always turns a non-human into a human.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Skeleton} race and drink a Potion of Polymorph or cast @mechanic{Polymorph} to take human form.
Eat any food while the polymorph is active.

achievements.description: Equip Funny Bones' weapon and cloak with no other equipment as a skeleton.
achievements.summary: As a true Skeleton, equip only the weapon and cloak carried by Funny Bones.

guide.context: Funny Bones is a rare champion Skeleton that can replace a normal skeleton in the Mines or the Underworld. Seed 1784434493 is a known way to find him.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Skeleton} race and find the champion @enemy{Funny Bones}, for example with seed 1784434493 in the Mines.
Kill Funny Bones and take its weapon and cloak.
Equip only that weapon and cloak, with no other gear.

achievements.description: Learn all of the base and secondary alchemy ingredients.
achievements.summary: Learn every base and secondary ingredient used in Alchemy.

guide.context: Potions are classed as base, secondary, or no unique use, and the category is visible only while an Alembic's brew screen is open. Alchemy levels 20, 40, and 60 each teach specific ingredients, and every fifth level can teach another at random.

steps.text: Combine potions in an @item{Alembic}; any result besides sickness or an explosion teaches one ingredient's use.
Drink potion types whose use is still unknown to learn them.
Keep raising the @mechanic{Alchemy} skill, since levels 20, 40, and 60 each teach ingredients.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with thrown potions.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 monsters with thrown potions.

guide.context: Firestorm is the simplest offensive potion to brew, and higher Alchemy raises thrown impact damage.

steps.text: Brew a damaging potion such as @item{Firestorm} at an Alembic.
Throw potions at monsters and let the impact kill 50 of them.

achievements.description: Eat 20 tin cans as a true goatman.
achievements.summary: As a true Goatman, consume 20 tin cans.

guide.context: A true Goatman can open tins without a tin opener, so no tool is needed. Food shops and Hamlet reliably stock tins.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Goatman} race and buy or loot tin cans.
Eat 20 tin cans.

achievements.description: Recruit three goatman allies as a true goatman.
achievements.summary: As a true Goatman, recruit three Goatman allies.

guide.context: The Leadership skill sets the follower limit and how many allies can be held at once, so train it if recruitment is blocked.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Goatman} race and raise @mechanic{Leadership} enough to hold three followers.
Recruit Goatman allies until three are following you.

achievements.description: Find extra potions from fountains 20 times as a true goatman.
achievements.summary: As a true Goatman, gain a bonus potion from a fountain 20 times.

guide.context: Fountains can bless gear, spawn Succubi or Incubi, or hand over an extra potion. The Gnomish Mines holds two guaranteed fountains.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Goatman} race and use every fountain you find.
Repeat until a fountain has given you an extra potion 20 times.

achievements.description: Summon two Skeleton Familiars at once.
achievements.summary: As a Conjurer, summon two Skeleton Familiars at the same time.

guide.context: The Conjurer's Conjure Skeleton summons an extra familiar once Mysticism reaches Expert, which is a combined INT plus Mysticism of 60.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Conjurer} class and train @mechanic{Mysticism} until INT plus Mysticism reaches 60.
Cast @mechanic{Conjure Skeleton} to summon two Skeleton Familiars at once.

achievements.description: Brew 50 potions using an Alembic.
achievements.summary: Brew 50 potions using an Alembic.

guide.context: Every brew action has a small chance to degrade the Alembic, and using acid raises that chance, so carry spares or brew cheap recipes.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Brewer} class, which begins with an @item{Alembic}, or find one in the dungeon.
Open the Alembic's brew screen, combine potions, and repeat 50 times.

achievements.description: Fill 50 empty bottles from sinks or fountains.
achievements.summary: Fill 50 empty bottles at sinks or fountains.

guide.context: Empty bottles appear when potions are drunk, and a Tinkering workbench can craft more from scrap.

steps.text: Gather empty bottles from finished potions or craft them at a @mechanic{workbench}.
Fill bottles at sinks or fountains until 50 have been filled.

achievements.description: Knockback 10 monsters into doors.
achievements.summary: Knock 10 monsters into doors, breaking the door with each impact.

guide.context: The door must break from the knockback, so damage it first. Rogue starts with Springshot Ammo, and Rats cannot open doors, which makes them easy lures.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Rogue} class for @item{Springshot Ammo}, or obtain knockback ammunition another way.
Attack a door until its health is low.
Lure a monster, ideally a @enemy{Rat}, beside the damaged door and hit it with Springshot Ammo so it is knocked into the door.
Repeat until 10 doors have been broken this way.

achievements.description: Paralyze a monster with Legendary Unarmed skill.
achievements.summary: Paralyze a monster with a fully charged Unarmed backstab at Legendary Unarmed skill.

guide.context: At Unarmed 100 a fully charged backstab paralyzes. The Monk has the game's highest Unarmed stat and can level it quickly against shopkeepers using the door-frame technique.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Monk} class and train @mechanic{Unarmed} to 100.
Sneak behind a monster and land a fully charged Unarmed backstab to paralyze it.

achievements.description: Accumulate 20 vials of blood at one time as a true Vampire.
achievements.summary: As a true Vampire, keep 20 blood vials in your inventory at once.

guide.context: Vampires drink blood as food, and blood drops from certain enemies while Vampiric Aura is active.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Vampire} race and keep @mechanic{Vampiric Aura} active so enemies drop blood.
Collect blood vials without drinking them until 20 are held at once.

achievements.description: Assassinate 50 targets while invisible as a true Vampire.
achievements.summary: As a true Vampire, assassinate 50 monsters from stealth while invisible.

guide.context: An assassination is a stealth kill from behind. The Accursed class provides the Invisible spell, or you can find an invisibility cape or ring.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Vampire} race, choosing the @mechanic{Accursed} class for @mechanic{Invisible} or equipping invisibility gear.
Become invisible, sneak behind monsters, and land stealth kills until 50 are assassinated.

achievements.description: Recruit a Young Vampire as a vampire.
achievements.summary: As a true Vampire, recruit a Young Vampire as an ally.

guide.context: Young Vampires appear rarely in the Ruins, often accompanied by Enslaved Ghouls.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Vampire} race and reach the @loc{Ruins}.
Find a @enemy{Young Vampire} and recruit it as a follower.

achievements.description: Lifesteal 500 HP from unarmed sneak-attack kills as an Accursed True Vampire.
achievements.summary: As an Accursed true Vampire, recover 500 HP with unarmed sneak-attack kills.

guide.context: Vampiric Aura gives unarmed attacks lifesteal, but the healing is wasted at full health, so stay injured.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Accursed} class as the @mechanic{Vampire} race and activate @mechanic{Vampiric Aura}.
Stay at low health and kill monsters with unarmed sneak attacks until 500 HP have been stolen.

achievements.description: Discover the effects of water as a true Vampire.
achievements.summary: As a true Vampire, enter water to discover what it does to you.

guide.context: The Swamp is the first area with standing water; simply entering a pool triggers the discovery.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Vampire} race and reach the @loc{Swamp}.
Walk into a pool of water.

achievements.description: Have a fountain bless your equipment as a true Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Succubus, keep using fountains until one blesses an equipped item.

guide.context: Succubi cannot remove blessed gear once it is worn, so use fountains on an item you are willing to keep. The Gnomish Mines holds two guaranteed fountains.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Succubus} race and use fountains, including the two in the @loc{Gnomish Mines}.
Keep using fountains until one blesses a piece of your equipment.

achievements.description: Curse a blessed weapon as a true Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Succubus, turn an already blessed weapon into a cursed one.

guide.context: Cursed Water curses one random item, so equip only the weapon you want changed. A Cursed Remove Curse Scroll or Cursed Enchant Weapon Scroll also works.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Succubus} race and equip a blessed weapon, removing every other item.
Apply @item{Cursed Water} to the weapon, or read a Cursed Remove Curse Scroll or Cursed Enchant Weapon Scroll while holding it.

achievements.description: Punch 50 enemies to death while drunk as a true Goatman.
achievements.summary: As a true Goatman, kill 50 monsters with bare fists while drunk.

guide.context: The drunk effect must be active for every kill, and the total carries over between runs.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Goatman} race and drink beer or booze until drunk.
Punch monsters to death while drunk, across as many runs as needed, until 50 die.

achievements.description: Recruit two incubi or succubi sumultaneously as a true Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Succubus, keep two Incubi or Succubi as followers at the same time.

guide.context: Both allies must be under your leadership at the same time; a first ally that has been dismissed or killed no longer counts.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Succubus} race and recruit an Incubus or Succubus, such as a @enemy{Succubus Consort} in @loc{Bram's Castle} or @loc{Hell}.
Nudge a second one beside the first and recruit it while the first is still following you.

achievements.description: Recruit a confused or drunk human as a true Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Succubus, recruit a Human that is confused or drunk.

guide.context: Charm Monster gains a large success bonus against drunk or confused targets.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Succubus} race and find a @npc{Human}, such as in @loc{Hamlet} or @loc{Minetown}.
Throw a @item{Confusion Potion} at the Human, then use @mechanic{Charm Monster} to recruit it.

achievements.description: Teleport while an enemy is attacking you in melee combat as a true Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Succubus, cast Teleportation while a monster is mid melee attack.

guide.context: The Succubus begins with the Teleportation spell, which moves the caster to a random spot on the current floor.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Succubus} race and let a monster begin its melee attack.
Cast @mechanic{Teleportation} during the attack.

achievements.description: Have a summoned familiar reach level 35.
achievements.summary: Raise a Conjurer's summoned Skeleton Familiar to level 35.

guide.context: A Conjure Skeleton summon keeps its level between casts, so the same familiar grows as you keep playing.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Conjurer} class and summon a Skeleton Familiar.
Keep that familiar alive as you level, recasting only after it dies, until it reaches level 35.

achievements.description: Relinquish the soul of a summoned familiar while you have zero MP.
achievements.summary: Destroy a summoned familiar with Relinquish Soul while you have no MP.

guide.context: Summons have a Relinquish Soul command that destroys the familiar and returns its mana to you.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Conjurer} class and summon a Skeleton Familiar.
Spend all of your MP.
Use the familiar's @mechanic{Relinquish Soul} command while your MP is empty.

achievements.description: Find a cure for the Accursed class.
achievements.summary: Cure the Accursed class by learning the Vampiric Aura spell.

guide.context: The Mystic Library, reached from the Ruins on floor 16, places a Vampiric Aura spellbook in a chest for the Accursed. Reading it lifts the curse but needs enough Mysticism and INT.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Accursed} class and find the @loc{Mystic Library} through the Ruins on floor 16.
Open the chest holding the @item{Vampiric Aura} spellbook and read it.

achievements.description: Cure your hangover 10 times in a single playthrough as a true Goatman.
achievements.summary: As a true Goatman, cure 10 hangovers in one playthrough.

guide.context: Beer inflicts a hangover once it wears off, and another beer cures it, so space the drinks out one at a time.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Goatman} race and collect at least 10 beers.
Drink one beer, wait for the hangover to begin, then drink another to cure it.
Repeat until 10 hangovers have been cured in the same run.

achievements.description: Reach Legendary Stealth while playing as the Accursed class.
achievements.summary: Raise Stealth to 100 while playing the Accursed class.

guide.context: Stealth gains from sneaking near monsters and from backstabbing, and secret levels hold extra targets.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Accursed} class.
Sneak behind monsters and land backstabs, hunting in secret levels for more enemies.
Continue until @mechanic{Stealth} reaches 100.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as the Accursed class without being cured, and with hunger enabled.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as an uncured Accursed of any race with hunger enabled.

guide.context: Learning Vampiric Aura from the Mystic Library cures the Accursed curse, so avoid that spellbook for this run.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Accursed} class and do not learn Vampiric Aura.
Leave the hunger setting turned on.
Reach the @loc{Sanctum} and defeat the final bosses.

achievements.description: Hold 16 different potions or bottled liquids in your inventory that don't need to be brewed first.
achievements.summary: Carry 16 different ready-made potions or bottled liquids at one time.

guide.context: Strength, Firestorm, Icestorm, and Thunderstorm are excluded because they only come from brewing. The 16 must be different kinds held together.

steps.text: Collect one of every ready-made potion and bottled liquid you can find, such as Healing, Water, Booze, or Juice.
Hold 16 different kinds in your inventory at the same time.

achievements.description: Damage multiple enemies with a single brewed unstable potion 20 times.
achievements.summary: Damage at least three monsters with one brewed storm potion, 20 times.

guide.context: Firestorm, Thunderstorm, and Icestorm each hit an area. The targets survive the hit, so the same group can be reused.

steps.text: Brew a storm potion at an @item{Alembic} and gather at least three monsters.
Throw the potion so three or more monsters take its damage.
Repeat 20 times.

achievements.description: Kill a lich with a  thrown potion.
achievements.summary: Land the final blow on a lich with a thrown potion.

guide.context: Storm potions such as Thunderstorm deal area damage. Baron Herx is the lich to target in his lair on floor 20.

steps.text: Brew a heavy storm potion.
Weaken a lich, then throw the potion to land the killing blow.

achievements.description: Allow 50 charmed allies to die in while in your service as a Mesmer.
achievements.summary: As a Mesmer, let 50 charmed followers die while in your service.

guide.context: Charm Monster brings a monster into your service; send it into danger or betray it yourself so it dies while still loyal.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Mesmer} class and charm monsters with @mechanic{Charm Monster}.
Let the followers die in fights or turn on them, then charm more.
Continue until 50 charmed allies have died in your service.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement earned by wearing out the Mesmer's signature staff.
achievements.summary: Break a Magicstaff of Charm by using it until its condition fails.

guide.context: Magic staffs lose condition as they are used to cast, so the staff keeps working until it finally breaks.

steps.text: Get the Mesmer's @item{Magicstaff of Charm}.
Keep casting from the staff until it breaks.

achievements.description: Attempt to charm a monster that cannot be tamed.
achievements.summary: Aim Charm Monster at a creature that cannot join your party.

guide.context: Charm Monster cannot tame bosses or the Minotaur, which makes the Minotaur the easiest failed target.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Mesmer} class and find the @enemy{Minotaur} in the Sand Labyrinth.
Cast @mechanic{Charm Monster} on the Minotaur; the failed charm unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Have your charmed allies kill 50 enemies.
achievements.summary: As a Mesmer, let your charmed followers land the killing blows on 50 monsters.

guide.context: Keep charmed followers alive with rest commands or healing so they can keep fighting.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Mesmer} class and charm a strong monster.
Keep the follower healed and rested, and let it land killing blows.
Continue until your charmed allies have killed 50 monsters.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy after you are dead using poison, fire, or thrown tinkered traps.
achievements.summary: Kill a monster with lingering poison, fire, or a tinkered trap after you die.

guide.context: The Rogue begins with Sickness and Poison potions, which makes lingering poison easy to set up.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Rogue} class, or otherwise get poison, fire, or a tinkered trap.
Poison or set a monster on fire, or leave a trap beside it.
Let the lingering effect kill the monster while your own HP is at zero.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy within 1 second of it teleporting.
achievements.summary: Kill a monster less than one second after it teleports.

guide.context: Teleport Other pulls a disoriented target toward you, and a disoriented monster cannot act until it is hit, so the follow-up lands quickly.

steps.text: Weaken a monster to low HP.
Cast @mechanic{Teleport Other} on it, then kill it within a second of the teleport.

achievements.description: Consume 50 non-magical book or scrolls as a true Automaton over the course of multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: As a true Automaton, consume 50 ordinary books or scrolls across runs.

guide.context: The journal in the spawn area counts, and the total carries across playthroughs.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Automaton} race.
Eat ordinary books and scrolls, starting with the journal in the spawn area.
Keep eating across runs until 50 have been consumed.

achievements.description: Recruit a Human ally and shop with a merchant while under the effects of polymorph as a true Automaton.
achievements.summary: As a polymorphed true Automaton, recruit a Human and then trade with a merchant.

guide.context: Humans treat Automatons as monsters and refuse to trade, but Polymorph always turns a non-human into a human.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Automaton} race and use @mechanic{Polymorph} to take human form.
Recruit a @npc{Human} ally while polymorphed.
Trade with a shopkeeper before the polymorph ends.
steps.note: Minetown and Hamlet keep a shop and Humans close together.

achievements.description: Accumulate 10 minutes of playtime with a superheated boiler as a true Automaton.
achievements.summary: As a true Automaton, bank 10 total minutes with a superheated boiler.

guide.context: The tracked time adds up over multiple runs, so the boiler does not need to stay hot for ten straight minutes.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Automaton} race and keep the boiler superheated as much as possible.
Accumulate 10 minutes of superheated time across runs.

achievements.description: Consume 100 scrap as a true Automaton.
achievements.summary: As a true Automaton, eat 100 scrap.

guide.context: Scrap is the Automaton's fuel. Salvage unwanted gear with a tinkering kit to build a stock of metal and magic scrap.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Automaton} race and gather metal and magic scrap.
Eat scrap until 100 have been consumed.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a true Automaton.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Automaton body, using any class.

guide.context: A true Automaton means playing the Automaton race itself rather than a polymorphed human.

steps.text: Start a run as the @mechanic{Automaton} race with any class.
Descend to floor 35 and defeat the bosses in the @loc{Sanctum}.

achievements.description: Recruit a total of 6 Succubus, Incubus or Humans as a true Incubus or Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Incubus or Succubus, recruit six Humans, Incubi, or Succubi in total.

guide.context: The recruits do not need to be alive at once; each one that joins counts toward the total.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Incubus} or @mechanic{Succubus} race.
Recruit Humans, Incubi, or Succubi one after another until six have joined.

achievements.description: Equip 4 cursed items at once as a true Incubus or Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Incubus or Succubus, equip four cursed items at the same time.

guide.context: Cursed Water is the simplest way to curse gear. Incubi and Succubi can wear cursed items and can still remove them.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Incubus} or @mechanic{Succubus} race and gather @item{Cursed Water}.
Curse several pieces of equipment with Cursed Water.
Equip four cursed items at once.

achievements.description: Gain 100 mana from Amulets of Strangulation as a true Incubus or Succubus.
achievements.summary: As a true Incubus or Succubus, regain 100 total mana from Amulets of Strangulation.

guide.context: Amulets of Strangulation restore mana when equipped, so empty your MP first to make room.

steps.text: Play the @mechanic{Incubus} or @mechanic{Succubus} race and collect @item{Amulets of Strangulation}.
Spend your MP low, then equip an amulet to regain mana.
Repeat until 100 total mana has been gained from the amulets.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies that are near a fountain as a true Incubus.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies while they are beside a fountain as a true Incubus.

steps.text: Start a run with the Incubus race and reach a floor that has a @loc{fountain}.
Craft a @item{Noisemaker} with a Tinkering Kit and throw it next to the fountain.
steps.note: The Noisemaker pulls nearby enemies toward wherever it lands.

steps.text: Kill enemies as they gather beside the fountain until 20 have died there.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a true Incubus.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Incubus body, using any class.

steps.text: Start a run with the Incubus race.
Descend through all 35 floors to the Sanctum.
Defeat Orpheus and Erudyce, then take the portal that appears.

achievements.description: Cast 20 different spells from spellbooks as a true Goblin in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Cast 20 different spells from spellbooks during a single run as a true Goblin.

guide.context: The Mystic Library on floor 16 is packed with spellbooks, so it is a good place to fill out the list.

steps.text: Start a run with the Goblin race.
Read spellbooks to learn spells, then cast each one straight from its book.
Cast 20 distinct spells before the run ends.

achievements.description: Burn 50 spellbooks to ash as a Goblin across multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 spellbooks through repeated use as a Goblin across multiple runs.

guide.context: A spellbook loses condition as it is used and falls apart once that condition runs out.

steps.text: Start a run as a Goblin and gather spellbooks.
Cast from each book until its condition runs out and it breaks.
steps.note: In split-screen a second character can read a book first to leave it torn, which speeds up the break.

steps.text: Repeat across runs until 50 spellbooks have been destroyed.

achievements.description: Reach Legendary skill in any melee weapon skill as a true Goblin.
achievements.summary: Raise any melee weapon skill to Legendary (100) while playing as a true Goblin.

guide.context: A skill turns Legendary at 100 points. Goblin characters gain melee skill levels less often than other races.

steps.text: Start a run with the Goblin race and equip a melee weapon.
Land hits with the same weapon type until that skill reaches 100.

achievements.description: Recruit 4 Goblins as a true Goblin.
achievements.summary: Recruit four Goblin followers while playing as a true Goblin.

guide.context: The Leadership skill decides how many followers you can keep at one time.

steps.text: Start a run with the Goblin race.
Recruit Goblins, which appear in the Swamp and Sand Labyrinth.
Build up a group of four recruited Goblins.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a true Goblin.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Goblin body, using any class.

steps.text: Start a run with the Goblin race.
Descend through all 35 floors to the Sanctum.
Defeat Orpheus and Erudyce, then take the portal that appears.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a spell that leaves you with 5 or fewer Energy as a true Insectoid.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a spell while your Energy is at 5 or lower as a true Insectoid.

guide.context: Insectoids start with the Spray Acid and Flutter spells, so they can cast without finding a spellbook.

steps.text: Start a run with the Insectoid race.
Spend Energy until the bar sits at 5 or below.
Kill an enemy with @item{Spray Acid} while the bar stays at 5 or less.

achievements.description: Gain 50 Magic Levels from reading or casting from Spellbooks as a true Insectoid over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Gain a combined 50 levels in Sorcery, Mysticism, and Thaumaturgy by reading and casting spellbooks as a true Insectoid across multiple runs.

guide.context: Sorcery, Mysticism, and Thaumaturgy each have their own skill, and casting a spell trains the school that owns it.

steps.text: Start a run with the Insectoid race and collect spellbooks.
Read each book to learn its spell, then cast it to raise the matching magic skill.
Repeat across runs until the three magic skills have gained 50 levels in total.

achievements.description: Gain access to an otherwise inaccessible area of the level by using Flutter.
achievements.summary: Use Flutter to cross a gap and reach a part of a level you could not otherwise get to.

guide.context: Flutter grants 12 seconds of levitation and is one of the Insectoid's starting spells.

steps.text: Play as an Insectoid so you begin with Flutter.
Find a pit or gap that cuts off part of the floor.
Cast @item{Flutter} and cross the gap before the levitation ends.

achievements.description: Have Insectoid allies kill 20 enemies for you as a true Insectoid.
achievements.summary: Have Insectoid allies land 20 killing blows while you play as a true Insectoid.

guide.context: Insectoids live in the Sand Labyrinth and Crystal Caves, so those floors are good recruiting grounds.

steps.text: Start a run with the Insectoid race and recruit Insectoid allies.
Take them into fights and let them land the killing blow.
Keep going until your Insectoid allies have claimed 20 kills.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a true Insectoid.
achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Insectoid body, using any class.

steps.text: Start a run with the Insectoid race.
Descend through all 35 floors to the Sanctum.
Defeat Orpheus and Erudyce, then take the portal that appears.

achievements.description: Achieve the killing blow against a minotaur using machines and / or traps.
achievements.summary: Deal the killing blow to a Minotaur with a tinkered trap or machine.

guide.context: Only the trap or robot damage counts, so wear the Minotaur down with normal attacks before it reaches the trigger.

steps.text: Play as a Mechanist, or pick up a trap from the Ruins.
Craft a damaging trap such as a @item{Flame Trap}, or build a @item{Sentrybot}.
Weaken a Minotaur, then lead it into the trap or robot fire for the last hit.

achievements.description: Use a Teleport Trap to send yourself to a part of the level that is otherwise inaccessible.
achievements.summary: Set off a Teleportation Trap on yourself to reach a part of the floor that cannot be walked to.

guide.context: A lockpick can change a trap's target mode so the blast moves you instead of an enemy.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Teleportation Trap} with a Tinkering Kit.
Use a @item{Lockpick} on the trap to switch it to targeting you.
Arm it and step on it, then check whether you land on a cut-off part of the floor.
steps.note: The landing spot is random, so this may take several attempts.

achievements.description: Recycle items into 1000 units of Scrap and Essence using Tinkering Toolkits.
achievements.summary: Salvage items into a combined total of 1000 Metal and Magic Scrap across multiple runs.

guide.context: Metal Scrap comes from ordinary gear, while Magic Scrap comes from magical, blessed, or cursed items.

steps.text: Get a @item{Tinkering Kit} and gather spare items.
Salvage them from the kit's Salvage tab or with the kit held in your off-hand.
Keep shredding across runs until 1000 scrap has been produced.

achievements.description: Have one of every crafted Tinkering item in your inventory.
achievements.summary: Keep at least one of every craftable Tinkering item in your inventory at the same time.

guide.context: The Backpack is the highest-tier craft and needs 80 tinkering plus Perception to make.

steps.text: Get a @item{Tinkering Kit} and gather enough Metal and Magic Scrap.
Craft one of each of the 16 Tinkering items, from the Beartrap to the Backpack.
steps.note: The full set is Beartrap, Empty Bottle, Glasses, Lockpick, Noisemaker, Dummybot, Gyrobot, Lantern, Freeze Trap, Sleep Trap, Flame Trap, Teleportation Trap, Sentrybot, Spellbot, Tech Goggles, and Backpack.

steps.text: Hold one of each in your inventory at the same time.

achievements.description: Repair or Salvage 100 Tinkered traps and machine allies.
achievements.summary: Repair or salvage a combined 100 tinkered traps and machine allies across multiple runs.

guide.context: A Tinkering Kit both fixes damaged craft and strips them back into scrap.

steps.text: Carry a @item{Tinkering Kit} and craft traps or robots.
Open the kit's Repair tab to fix damaged ones, or salvage them instead.
Repeat across runs until 100 repairs or salvages are logged.

achievements.description: Gain 100 Scrap from salvaging torches.
achievements.summary: Salvage torches for a total of 100 scrap across multiple runs.

guide.context: Torches are mounted on dungeon walls and can be taken down like loose items.

steps.text: Take torches off dungeon walls as you explore.
Salvage them with a @item{Tinkering Kit}.
Repeat across runs until 100 scrap has come from torches.

achievements.description: Command a Gyrobot to grab an item or interact with a switch that is otherwise inaccessible.
achievements.summary: Have a Gyrobot fetch an item or use a switch that you cannot reach.

guide.context: A Gyrobot floats over pits and, at Intricate quality or better, can flip levers and pick up items.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Gyrobot} of Intricate quality or higher.
Take it to a switch or item that sits across a pit or barrier.
Command the Gyrobot to grab the item or pull the lever.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for letting a Gyrobot meet its end under a falling boulder.
achievements.summary: Have a Gyrobot crushed by a falling boulder.

guide.context: Boulder traps fire when anything steps on the trigger plate, and that includes your own robot.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Gyrobot} with a Tinkering Kit.
Find a @mechanic{Boulder Trap} and send the Gyrobot onto its trigger plate.
Let the boulder drop on the robot.

achievements.description: Kill 50 webbed enemies as a Spider over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Webbed enemies while in Spider form across multiple runs.

guide.context: Spider form is the Shaman's Arthropod Form, which grants the Spray Web and Poison spells.

steps.text: Play a Shaman and shapeshift with @item{Arthropod Form}.
Hit an enemy with @item{Spray Web} to apply the Webbed status.
Kill the webbed enemy, then repeat across runs until 50 are dead.

achievements.description: Pick up 50 detected food items as a Rat over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Pick up 50 food items revealed by Detect Food while in Rat form across multiple runs.

guide.context: Rat form is a Shaman shapeshift that grants the Detect Food spell, which marks food on the map.

steps.text: Play a Shaman and shapeshift with @item{Rat Form}.
Cast @item{Detect Food} and walk to the marked food.
Pick up each marked item and repeat across runs until 50 are collected.

achievements.description: Acquire 3 Troll allies, break 3 walls, and cast Fear on 3 characters as a Troll in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: As a Troll in one run, recruit three Trolls, break three walls, and cast Fear on three different enemies.

guide.context: Troll form is a Shaman shapeshift that lets you recruit Troll followers; the Gnomish Mines holds many.
