steps.text: Play a Shaman and shapeshift with @item{Troll Form}.
Recruit three Trolls, such as the ones in the Gnomish Mines.
Break three walls with a @item{Pickaxe}.
Cast @item{Fear} on three different enemies.
steps.note: All four conditions must be met in the same run.

achievements.description: Recruit 50 allies while Shapeshifted or Polymorphed as a Shaman over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Recruit 50 allies while in a shapeshifted or polymorphed form as a Shaman across multiple runs.

guide.context: Each Shaman animal form attracts matching creatures: rats, spiders, trolls, and imps.

steps.text: Play a Shaman and shapeshift into an animal form.
Recruit the creatures that form attracts.
Repeat across runs until 50 allies have been recruited while transformed.

achievements.description: Enscribe 50 scrolls with the Magic Quill as a Shaman over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Scribe 50 scrolls with a Magic Quill as a Shaman across multiple runs.

guide.context: Scribing combines the Enchanted Feather, called the Magic Quill, with blank scrolls to write a new scroll.

steps.text: Play as a Shaman and collect blank scrolls.
Use the @item{Enchanted Feather} on a blank scroll to inscribe a scroll.
Repeat across runs until 50 scrolls have been written.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with the whip shortly after teleporting them over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with the Whip soon after teleporting them across multiple runs.

guide.context: The Punisher starts with the Whip and the Teleport Other spell, and teleported targets are left disoriented.

steps.text: Play as a Punisher and wield the @item{Whip}.
Weaken an enemy, then hit it with @item{Teleport Other} to pull it in front of you.
Kill it with the Whip before it recovers, then repeat across runs until 50 are dead.

achievements.description: Use the whip to disarm a target's melee weapon, pick up the weapon, and use it to kill the same target.
achievements.summary: Disarm an enemy with the Whip, take its weapon, and kill it with that weapon.

guide.context: Teleport Other cast from long range leaves a target disoriented, which makes the Whip strip its weapon more reliably.

steps.text: Play as a Punisher and wield the @item{Whip}.
Teleport an enemy from as far away as you can to disorient it.
Hit it with the Whip until its melee weapon drops.
Pick up the dropped weapon and finish that enemy with it.

achievements.description: Have 30 Enemies kill themselves under retaliation from an Inner Demon over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Make 30 enemies die from the damage they deal to a summoned Inner Demon across multiple runs.

guide.context: Inner Demon is a Punisher spell, and any harm the victim does to the demon is reflected onto the attacker.

steps.text: Play as a Punisher and cast @item{Inner Demon} on an enemy.
Stay back and let the enemy attack the demon.
Repeat across runs until 30 enemies have killed themselves on it.

achievements.description: Teleport to and assassinate 20 marked enemies in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Mark 20 enemies with Arcane Mark and backstab each by teleporting to it in a single run.

guide.context: Arcane Mark focuses your Teleportation spell onto the marked target, dropping you behind it.

steps.text: Play as a true Incubus, who starts with @item{Arcane Mark} and @item{Teleportation}.
Damage an enemy, then hit it with Arcane Mark.
Cast Teleportation to arrive behind the marked enemy and land a stealth attack.
Repeat until 20 marked enemies have been assassinated.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies disabled by slow, sleep or paralyze effects with an axe as a Punisher over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with an axe while they are slowed, asleep, or paralyzed as a Punisher across multiple runs.

guide.context: A Slow staff or a spell such as Sleep or Stoneblood leaves a target unable to fight back.

steps.text: Play as a Punisher and wield an @item{Axe}.
Apply Slow, Sleep, or Paralysis to an enemy.
Kill the disabled enemy with the axe, repeating across runs until 50 are down.

achievements.description: Inflict bleeding status on 50 enemies while wearing the executioner's hood over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Apply bleeding to 50 enemies while the Executioner's Hood is equipped as a Punisher across multiple runs.

guide.context: The Punisher starts with the Executioner's Hood, which can open bleeding wounds on a hit.

steps.text: Play as a Punisher with the @item{Executioner's Hood} equipped.
Strike enemies until the bleeding status lands.
Repeat across runs until 50 enemies have been bled.

achievements.description: Hold a crossbow, bow and all ammo types in your inventory at once as a Hunter.
achievements.summary: Carry a Bow, a Crossbow, and every ammo type together in your pack as a Hunter.

guide.context: There are seven ammo types, and Scrolls of Conjure Arrow can produce any you are missing.

steps.text: Play as a Hunter.
Carry a @item{Bow} and a @item{Crossbow}.
Collect all seven ammo types, using @item{Scrolls of Conjure Arrow} for any gaps.
Hold every piece in your inventory at the same time.

achievements.description: Have the Boomerang return to you 100 times after hitting an enemy over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Have the Boomerang return after hitting an enemy 100 times across multiple runs.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Boomerang} and throw it at enemies.
Let it come back after each connected hit.
Repeat across runs until 100 returns have followed a hit.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel without ever hitting an enemy with a melee weapon as a Hunter from the beginning of the game.
achievements.summary: Reach the end of the Citadel without landing a single melee hit as a Hunter from the start of the run.

guide.context: Ranger mode disables melee attacks entirely, which stops an accidental hit from breaking the run.

steps.text: Start a run as the Hunter class.
Type /rangermode in chat to lock out melee attacks.
Deal all damage with ranged weapons and spells through the Citadel, then finish floor 35.

achievements.description: Use swift ammunition while wielding the compound bow to score 10 hits on enemies in a short amount of time.
achievements.summary: Land 10 hits on enemies in quick succession with swift ammunition from the Compound Bow.

guide.context: A Compound Bow can be picked up in both Hamlet and the Crystal Caves.

steps.text: Get a @item{Compound Bow} from Hamlet or the Crystal Caves.
Equip swift ammunition.
Land 10 hits on enemies inside a short window.

achievements.description: Do a very large amount of damage to an enemy using a ranged weapon with a single shot.
achievements.summary: Deal an extremely high amount of damage to one enemy with a single ranged shot.

guide.context: A heavily blessed, powerful bow such as an Arbalest makes the damage threshold reachable.

steps.text: Get a high-damage ranged weapon such as an @item{Arbalest}.
Bless or enchant it to raise its damage.
Hit one enemy with a single fully charged shot.

achievements.description: Hit an enemy with Hunting or Fire Ammo, and then stall them with Springshot Ammo.
achievements.summary: Apply Hunting or Fire Ammo to an enemy, then stall it with Springshot Ammo.

steps.text: Carry @item{Hunting Ammo} or @item{Fire Ammo} and some @item{Springshot Ammo}.
steps.note: The Rogue class starts with Springshot Ammo.

steps.text: Hit an enemy with the Hunting or Fire Ammo.
Follow up with a Springshot Ammo hit to stop it in place.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where a true Incubus and Succubus are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a true Incubus and a true Succubus in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a true Incubus and another as a true Succubus.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where a true Vampire and an Insectoid are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a true Vampire and a true Insectoid in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a true Vampire and another as a true Insectoid.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where a true Automaton and Skeleton are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a true Automaton and a true Skeleton in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a true Automaton and another as a true Skeleton.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where a true Goatman and Goblin are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a true Goatman and a true Goblin in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a true Goatman and another as a true Goblin.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where a Mechanist and a Mesmer are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a Mechanist and a Mesmer in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a Mechanist and another as a Mesmer.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where an Accursed and a Punisher are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with an Accursed and a Punisher in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as an Accursed and another as a Punisher.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game where a Shaman and Conjurer are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a Shaman and a Conjurer in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a Shaman and another as a Conjurer.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in cooperative game where a Hunter and Brewer are in the party.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Mines in a co-op game with a Hunter and a Brewer in the party.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the floor 5 transition ladder; the Assist Shrine in Minehead can change a race or class before the run.

steps.text: Start a co-op game with one player as a Hunter and another as a Brewer.
Clear floors 1 through 5 of the Mines.
Enter the exit ladder on floor 5.

achievements.description: Play as every DLC class and race.
achievements.summary: Start a game with every DLC race and every DLC class at least once.

guide.context: Human characters can pick any DLC class, and each monster race's own class is also open to that race.

steps.text: Begin a game with each DLC race: Skeleton, Vampire, Succubus, Goatman, Automaton, Incubus, Goblin, Insectoid, Gnome, Gremlin, Dryad, Myconid, and Salamander.
Begin a game with each DLC class: Shaman, Conjurer, Hunter, Brewer, Punisher, Accursed, Mesmer, Mechanist, Bard, Sapper, Scion, Hermit, and Paladin.
Start the run for each pick, then quit and select the next one.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for letting a true Automaton's boiler run cold until it dies.
achievements.summary: Die as a true Automaton from the effects of a cold boiler.

guide.context: An Automaton keeps its boiler hot by consuming items; once the boiler goes cold the character starves to death.

steps.text: Start a run with the Automaton race.
Keep the character from consuming anything so the boiler cools.
Wait until the cold boiler kills you.

achievements.description: Have a crossbow sentry, magic sentry and gyrocopter all active at once.
achievements.summary: Keep a Sentrybot, a Spellbot, and a Gyrobot deployed and active at the same time.

guide.context: Sentrybots fire ranged bolts, Spellbots cast magic, and the Gyrobot is the flying helper craft.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Sentrybot}, a @item{Spellbot}, and a @item{Gyrobot}.
Deploy all three on the same floor.
Keep each one alive and active until the achievement fires.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies while they are attacking Dummybots over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies that are focused on a Dummybot across multiple runs.

guide.context: A Dummybot soaks up enemy attacks and can also train your weapon skill while foes hit it.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Dummybot} and place it where enemies will gather.
Attack enemies while they are preoccupied with the Dummybot.
steps.note: Bring enemies to low health first so you can clear them before the Dummybot breaks.

steps.text: Repeat across runs until 20 kills are made this way.

achievements.description: Kill 20 enemies who are being drawn towards a Noisemaker.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies that are walking toward a Noisemaker across multiple runs.

guide.context: A thrown Noisemaker pulls nearby enemies to it, and kills on enemies investigating it also train Tinkering.

steps.text: Craft or find a @item{Noisemaker} and weaken a group of enemies.
Throw the Noisemaker and kill enemies as they move toward it.
Repeat across runs until 20 kills are made this way.

achievements.description: Have 5 bombs triggered by a single foe within 5 seconds.
achievements.summary: Have a single monster trigger five of your bombs within 5 seconds.

steps.text: Craft at least five @item{Flame Traps} with a @item{tinkering kit}.
Lure a durable monster such as the @enemy{Minotaur} into a small room.
Stack all five Flame Traps on one tile and let the monster step onto them.
Keep the monster on the stack until every trap detonates within 5 seconds.

achievements.description: Throw a damaging bomb at a foe who was put to sleep by a sleep bomb.
achievements.summary: Put a monster to sleep with a sleep trap, then hit it with a damaging trap.

steps.text: Craft a @item{Sleep Trap} and a damaging trap such as a @item{Flame Trap} or @item{Freeze Trap}.
Place the Sleep Trap where a monster will walk over it.
Wait until the monster falls asleep.
Throw the damaging trap onto the sleeping monster.

achievements.description: Have at least 4 sentries target the same monster at once.
achievements.summary: Have four or more sentries target one monster at the same time.

guide.context: The Tinkering skill raises how many robots you can keep deployed at once, so train it before setting this up.

steps.text: Craft enough @item{Sentrybots} to keep four deployed at once.
Place the four Sentrybots close together.
Lure a durable monster into their line of sight.
Hold the monster in place until all four sentries fire at it.

achievements.description: Consume 10 Scrolls of Fire as a true Automaton.
achievements.summary: Eat ten Scrolls of Fire while playing a true Automaton.

steps.text: Start a run as a true @npc{Automaton}.
Use the @item{Scroll of Fire} in your starting inventory.
Repeat a fresh run until ten Scrolls of Fire have been used.

achievements.description: Complete all Trials in the Hall of Trials.
achievements.summary: Finish every Trial in the Hall of Trials.

guide.context: The Hall of Trials holds ten separate Trials, and the hub links to each of them.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Hall of Trials} and enter its hub.
Enter each of the ten Trials from the hub.
Complete all ten Trials.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for falling during a Trial in the Hall of Trials.
achievements.summary: Die inside any one of the Trials in the Hall of Trials.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Hall of Trials} hub.
Start any Trial.
Let your character die during the Trial.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for locating the Master's Wing in the Hall of Trials hub.
achievements.summary: Locate the Master's Wing somewhere in the Hall of Trials hub.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Hall of Trials} hub.
Search the hub and enter the @loc{Master's Wing}.

achievements.description: Complete all Trials with a combined completion time of less than 20 minutes.
achievements.summary: Clear all ten Trials with a combined time under 20 minutes.

steps.text: Learn the layout of each Trial before starting a timed set.
Start a fresh set of Trials in the @loc{Hall of Trials}.
Complete every Trial and keep the combined timer below 20 minutes.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for finishing a Trial after a lich has been encountered.
achievements.summary: Complete a Trial after encountering a lich in an earlier run.

guide.context: Meeting Baron Herx or the Sanctum's twin bosses counts as encountering a lich.

steps.text: Meet Baron Herx or the twin bosses in the Sanctum during a run.
Return to the @loc{Hall of Trials} hub.
Finish any Trial.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for dying inside the Hall of Trials hub.
achievements.summary: Kill your character while standing in the Hall of Trials hub.

guide.context: A @item{Gyrobot} can be ordered to pull a lever that fires a hub spike trap.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Hall of Trials} hub.
Trigger a hub trap, such as a @mechanic{spike trap}, to finish yourself off.

achievements.description: Find a secret area in each of the 10 Trials in the Hall of Trials.
achievements.summary: Reveal the hidden room in each of the ten Trials.

guide.context: Every one of the ten Trials hides its own secret area, and each one counts separately.

steps.text: Enter a Trial in the @loc{Hall of Trials}.
Search the Trial for a concealed passage or side room.
Reach the secret area, then repeat for all ten Trials.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a Punisher of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Punisher of any race.

guide.context: The Punisher is a Legends and Pariahs DLC class.

steps.text: Start a run with the @npc{Punisher} class.
Defeat Baron Herx and escape the Citadel.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a Shaman of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Shaman of any race.

guide.context: The Shaman is a Legends and Pariahs DLC class.

steps.text: Start a run with the @npc{Shaman} class.
Defeat Baron Herx and escape the Citadel.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a Mechanist of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Mechanist of any race.

guide.context: The Mechanist is a Legends and Pariahs DLC class.

steps.text: Start a run with the @npc{Mechanist} class.
Defeat Baron Herx and escape the Citadel.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a Hunter of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Hunter of any race.

guide.context: The Hunter is a Legends and Pariahs DLC class.

steps.text: Start a run with the @npc{Hunter} class.
Defeat Baron Herx and escape the Citadel.

achievements.description: Don 30 different pieces of head and face equipment over multiple playthroughs, excluding starting class items.
achievements.summary: Wear 30 different head or face items across multiple runs, not counting class starting gear.

guide.context: Head and face equipment are separate slots, so a helmet and a mask each count as one of the 30.

steps.text: Collect head and face equipment from chests, shops, and enemies.
Equip each different piece once.
Keep collecting and wearing new pieces across runs until 30 are recorded.

achievements.description: Help followers gain a full level just based on the bonus XP given by Inspiration.
achievements.summary: Use Inspiration to give a follower enough bonus experience for a full level.

steps.text: Wear a crown-type head item that grants the @mechanic{Inspiration} effect.
Keep a follower close while the effect is active.
Let the bonus experience carry the follower through an entire level.

achievements.description: Survive being crushed by a boulder only because you're wearing a Top Hat or Mining Helmet.
achievements.summary: Survive a boulder crushing you because you wear a Top Hat or Mining Helmet.

guide.context: The head item must be what saves you, so the unlock only registers if you live through the crushing blow.

steps.text: Wear a @item{Top Hat} or @item{Mining Helmet}.
Let a falling or rolling @mechanic{boulder} crush you.
Survive the hit.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for being devoured by a Mimic.
achievements.summary: Be killed by a Mimic.

guide.context: Mimics disguise themselves as chests, and either chest on a transition floor can be one.

steps.text: Find a chest that is secretly a @enemy{Mimic}.
Stay in melee range and let the Mimic kill you.

achievements.description: Have 10 pieces of your gear stolen by a Mimic over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Lose ten pieces of equipment to Mimics across multiple runs.

guide.context: Transition floors always hold two chests, and either one can be a Mimic.

steps.text: Let a @enemy{Mimic} attack and eat a piece of your gear.
Block with a shield so the Mimic eats the shield first.
Repeat across runs until ten items have been stolen.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for killing a Mimic with the Locking spell.
achievements.summary: Kill a Mimic with damage from the Locking spell.

guide.context: Locking usually locks doors and containers, but it suffocates a Mimic.

steps.text: Start a run with the @npc{Sexton} class, which begins with the @mechanic{Locking} spell.
Find a chest that is secretly a @enemy{Mimic} and keep it closed.
Cast Locking at the Mimic until it suffocates.

achievements.description: Woo an Incubus or Succubus with a romantic gesture.
achievements.summary: Woo an Incubus or Succubus using a romantic gesture.

guide.context: Succubi can appear from fountains, and lesser Incubi spawn in the Sand Labyrinth and Ruins.

steps.text: Find an @enemy{Incubus} or @enemy{Succubus}.
Use a romantic gesture on it to win it over.

achievements.description: Equip a blessed Wolf Hood.
achievements.summary: Equip a blessed Wolf Hood.

guide.context: A fountain blesses one equipped item at random. Unlike most races, Succubus and Incubus characters cannot remove a blessed item normally.

steps.text: Find a @item{Wolf Hood} and remove your other gear.
Use a @mechanic{fountain} until the blessing lands on the Wolf Hood.
Equip the blessed Wolf Hood.

achievements.description: Take damage from negative health regeneration caused by the Pipe.
achievements.summary: Take damage from the Pipe's negative health regeneration.

guide.context: Turn hunger off, or wear a @item{Vampire Doublet}, so ordinary regeneration does not cancel the damage.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Pipe}.
Wait for its drain to reduce your health.

achievements.description: Recruit an NPC of the opposite sex while wearing a full face mask.
achievements.summary: Recruit an opposite-sex NPC while a full face mask covers your face.

guide.context: Leadership raises how many followers you can recruit at once.

steps.text: Put on a full face mask item.
Recruit an NPC whose sex differs from your character's.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in your first attempt to the Leaderboards for 12 different Seed Events.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines on a first attempt and reach the leaderboards for twelve different Seed Events.

guide.context: Only a first attempt counts for each event, so a retry does not feed the total.

steps.text: Open a @mechanic{Seed Event} and play it.
Escape the Mines without retrying.
Submit the result to the leaderboard.
Repeat for twelve different Seed Events.

achievements.description: Win any Seed Event.
achievements.summary: Win any Seed Event.

guide.context: Seed Events are fixed-seed challenge runs that keep their own leaderboards.

steps.text: Start a @mechanic{Seed Event} from the Seed Events menu.
Play through it and finish with the best score.

achievements.description: Replay a Seed Event and submit a better Top Score after escaping the Mines.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in a Seed Event twice and beat your earlier score.

steps.text: Escape the Mines in a Seed Event and submit the score.
Replay the same Seed Event.
Escape the Mines again with a higher score.

achievements.description: Reach the Swamps in a Seed Event with another player in a cooperative game.
achievements.summary: Reach the Swamp in a cooperative Seed Event with at least one other player.

guide.context: Reaching the Swamp means clearing the Mines' floors 1-5 and taking the level 5 exit.

steps.text: Start a Seed Event in cooperative mode.
Bring at least one other player into the party.
Escape the Mines together and arrive in the Swamp.

achievements.description: Slay a lich or devil in a Seed Event where your Class or Race is predetermined.
achievements.summary: Defeat a devil or lich inside a Seed Event that fixes your race or class.

guide.context: Baron Herx and the Sanctum twins are liches, while Baphomet is a devil.

steps.text: Start a Seed Event that predetermines your class or race.
Reach the boss and defeat Baron Herx, Baphomet, or the Sanctum twins.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for whiffing 81 melee swings at Bats.
achievements.summary: Swing a melee weapon at Bats and miss 81 times across runs.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Bat}.
Attack it with a melee weapon and let the strike miss.
Repeat until 81 misses are recorded.

achievements.description: Destroy a Bugbear's Scutum while it is defending.
achievements.summary: Smash a Bugbear's Scutum while the Bugbear is defending with it.

guide.context: Bugbears inhabit the Ruins on floors 16-20.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Bugbear} in the @loc{Ruins}.
Attack while it raises its @item{Scutum}.
Keep hitting until the Scutum breaks.

achievements.description: Gain the Speed effect after touching a Daedalus Shrine.
achievements.summary: Touch a Daedalus Shrine and receive the Speed effect.

guide.context: Daedalus Shrines normally reveal the floor's exit and can also grant the Speed effect.

steps.text: Find a @mechanic{Daedalus Shrine} on a dungeon floor.
Touch it and keep interacting until the Speed effect appears.

achievements.description: A hidden achievement for speed-brewing a recipe right after opening the Compendium's Alchemy page.
achievements.summary: Brew a recorded potion recipe within 10 seconds of opening its Compendium page.

guide.context: Researching the Alchemy entry costs lore points and unlocks its recipe chart.

steps.text: Research the @mechanic{Alchemy} entry in the @mechanic{Compendium} so its recipes show.
Have an @item{alembic} and the two recipe potions ready.
Open the Alchemy page and brew that potion within 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Research any Compendium Entry.
achievements.summary: Spend lore to research any entry in the Compendium.

guide.context: Lore points build up as you play and are the cost of researching entries.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Compendium}.
Pick any entry and spend lore points to research it.

achievements.description: Discover every entry in the World tab of the Compendium.
achievements.summary: Fill in every entry in the Compendium's World tab.

guide.context: The World tab tracks the creatures you have discovered during play.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Compendium} and switch to the World tab.
Encounter the creatures listed there across runs.
Keep going until no entry is left blank.

achievements.description: Kill a Gnome by dropping a bell on it.
achievements.summary: Crush a Gnome to death with a dropped bell.

steps.text: Weaken a melee @enemy{Gnome} and lead it under a @item{bell}.
Block its hits with a shield.
Use fire, such as a @item{Firestaff} or fire arrows, to drop the bell on the Gnome.

achievements.description: Break 20 bells over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Break twenty bells across multiple runs.

steps.text: Find @item{bells} hanging in the dungeon.
Break them with attacks or fire.
Repeat across runs until twenty bells are destroyed.

achievements.description: Destroy 500 breakable containers using melee attacks over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Smash five hundred breakable containers with melee attacks across runs.

guide.context: Only containers destroyed by melee hits count, so ranged and magic kills do not add to the total.

steps.text: Attack barrels, crates, and other breakable objects with a melee weapon.
Keep breaking them across runs until five hundred are destroyed.

achievements.description: Have 4 or more different kinds of keys on you at one time.
achievements.summary: Carry four or more different key types at the same time.

guide.context: Key types include the Skeleton key and the Bronze, Iron, Silver, and Gold keys.

steps.text: Collect keys of different types during a run.
Hold at least four kinds in your inventory at once.

achievements.description: Pick 20 Iron, Bronze, or Silver Locks over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Pick twenty Iron, Bronze, or Silver locks across multiple runs.

guide.context: Lockpicking odds and the damage dealt to a lock both scale with Tinkering skill.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Tinkering} and carry @item{lockpicks}.
Unlock chests and doors that use Iron, Bronze, or Silver locks.
Keep picking locks across runs until twenty are opened.

achievements.description: Use Bronze, Silver, and Gold Keys to access 20 treasure rooms over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Open twenty treasure rooms with Bronze, Silver, or Gold keys across runs.

steps.text: Find Bronze, Silver, and Gold keys.
Use them to open locked treasure rooms.
Repeat across runs until twenty rooms have been opened.

achievements.description: Brew or cook 50 items at a Cauldron across multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Brew or cook fifty items at Cauldrons across multiple runs.

guide.context: Cauldrons appear randomly on levels and allow free cooking and brewing.

steps.text: Find a @item{Cauldron} on a dungeon floor.
Brew potions or cook rations at it.
Repeat across runs until fifty items have been made.

achievements.description: Craft 50 items at a Workbench across multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Craft fifty items at Workbenches across multiple runs.

guide.context: Workbenches have unlimited uses and also train Tinkering when you craft at them.

steps.text: Find a @item{Workbench} on a dungeon floor.
Craft tinkering items at it.
Repeat across runs until fifty items are crafted.

achievements.description: Have 4 or more Tier 4 Bardic Song effects active at one time from Bard Instruments.
achievements.summary: Play Bard instruments until four or more Tier 4 Bardic Songs are active at once.

guide.context: Tier 2 songs unlock at 5 Charisma, Tier 3 at 20, and Tier 4 at 40.

steps.text: Play the @npc{Bard} class and raise Charisma.
Reach 40 CHR so Tier 4 songs can be played.
Play different Bard instruments until four Tier 4 songs are active together.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies while under the effects of a Holy Symbol over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Kill fifty enemies while a Holy Symbol's effect is active across runs.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{Symbol of Sanctuary}.
Activate it to gain the Holy Symbol effect.
Kill enemies while the effect lasts.
Repeat across runs until fifty kills are recorded.

achievements.description: Gain 10 consecutive levels with a Bard Song active in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Gain ten levels in a row while a Bard Song is active in one run.

steps.text: Play the @npc{Bard} class.
Keep a Bard Song playing in the early game and play solo.
Level up ten times in a row without letting the song drop.

achievements.description: Slay a fire creature using Breathe Fire as a true Salamander.
achievements.summary: Kill a fire creature with Breathe Fire while playing a true Salamander.

guide.context: Breathe Fire is a Salamander-only spell that inflicts burning.

steps.text: Play a true @npc{Salamander}.
Find a fire creature such as a @enemy{Fire Slime} or @enemy{Imp}.
Cast @mechanic{Breathe Fire} on it until it dies.

achievements.description: Extinguish yourself while on fire as a true Dryad by using Germinate.
achievements.summary: Put out your own burning with Germinate while playing a true Dryad.

guide.context: Germinate is a Dryad-only spell that plants a shrub.

steps.text: Play a true @npc{Dryad}.
Set yourself on fire, or have another player hand you a @item{Scroll of Fire}.
Cast @mechanic{Germinate} while you are burning.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with a Flail while they are rooted by Bolas over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Root enemies with Bolas, then finish fifty of them with a Flail across runs.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{Flail} and @item{Bolas}.
Throw Bolas to root an enemy in place.
Kill the rooted enemy with the Flail.
Repeat across runs until fifty kills are counted.

achievements.description: Knockback 50 Slippery enemies in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Knock 50 enemies made slippery by Grease Balls sliding backward in a single playthrough.

guide.context: The same slippery enemy can be knocked back over and over, so one grease patch can supply most of the 50 hits.

steps.text: Cook 4 Rations together with a Towel in a frypan to create @item{Grease Balls}.
Throw a Grease Ball at an enemy to coat it in slippery grease.
Punch the slippery enemy so the hit knocks it sliding backward; keep hitting it until 50 slippery knockbacks are counted.

achievements.description: Prepare 100 rations over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Prepare a lifetime total of 100 rations across multiple playthroughs.

steps.text: Cook two different foods together in a frypan or at a cauldron to make rations, and keep cooking until 100 rations have been prepared in total.

achievements.description: Consume one of each flavor of seasoned ration in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Eat one Hearty, Sweet, Bitter, Sour, Spicy, and Herbal ration during a single playthrough.

guide.context: Every flavored ration is built from 4 Rations, so all six need 24 Rations. The Herbal Ration can use the Infected Branch Bow guaranteed in the Jungle Temple.

steps.text: Cook 4 Rations with a Potion of Healing, Booze, or Strength to make a Hearty Ration, then eat it.
Cook 4 Rations with a Potion of Speed, Cure Ailment, Restore Magic, or Fruit Juice to make a Sweet Ration, then eat it.
Cook 4 Rations with a Potion of Sickness, Acid, Polymorph, or Confusion, or a Dust Ball, to make a Bitter Ration, then eat it.
Cook 4 Rations with a Potion of Extra Healing, Invisibility, Levitation, or Blindness to make a Sour Ration, then eat it.
Cook 4 Rations with a Potion of Firestorm, Icestorm, Thunderstorm, or Paralysis to make a Spicy Ration, then eat it.
Cook 4 Rations with a Rose, Marigold, Sweetgrass Sprig, or Infected Branch Bow to make a Herbal Ration, then eat it.

achievements.description: Have 25 grease fires active at once.
achievements.summary: Have 25 grease fires burning at once.

guide.context: Grease Balls leave flammable patches, and fire spreads across them. A Salamander can ignite the grease with the Breathe Fire spell.

steps.text: As a @npc{Salamander} @npc{Sapper}, cook Rations into @item{Grease Balls} at a frypan.
Throw the Grease Balls onto the ground until several patches overlap in one area.
Breathe fire across the grease so many patches ignite together, then add more grease until 25 fires are active at the same moment.

achievements.description: Blind 4 different targets within 5 seconds using Slop Balls.
achievements.summary: Blind four different targets with Slop Balls within five seconds.

steps.text: Cook 4 Rations with a Potion of Water to make @item{Slop Balls}.
Gather four enemies close together, such as in Minetown or Hamlet.
Throw a Slop Ball at each of the four targets within five seconds so all four are blinded in time.

achievements.description: Pick up Rations provided by another player while hungry.
achievements.summary: Pick up a Ration dropped by another player while your character is hungry.

steps.text: Start a cooperative game with another player and let your character's hunger drop until the hungry status appears.
Have the other player drop a Ration, then pick it up while still hungry.

achievements.description: Anger the dead by defiling graves with the Deface spell.
achievements.summary: Get killed by a Shadow that rises from a grave you defiled with the Deface spell.

guide.context: Each defiled grave has a 13.5% chance to raise a Shadow, and the Haunted Castle holds many graves.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Gremlin} and cast the @item{Deface} spell on a grave.
Clear or avoid the ordinary enemies while waiting for a @enemy{Shadow} to rise from the defiled grave.
Let the Shadow kill your character without fighting back.

achievements.description: Use the Deface spell on 20 objects in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Destroy 20 objects with the Deface spell in a single playthrough.

guide.context: Deface only crumbles sinks, gravestones, workbenches, and cauldrons, and only Gremlins can cast it.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Gremlin}, which starts with the @item{Deface} spell.
Cast Deface on sinks, gravestones, workbenches, and cauldrons until 20 objects are destroyed.

achievements.description: Relearn and forget the same spell 5 times using the Scion's scepter.
achievements.summary: Learn and forget the same spell five times with the Scion's scepter.

steps.text: Play a @npc{Scion} and use the class scepter to relearn one spell, then use it to forget that same spell.
Repeat the relearn-and-forget pair on one spell until each action has been logged five times.

achievements.description: Kill enemies with the Shillelagh while they have 3 or more debuffs on them 20 times in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with the Shillelagh while each has three or more debuffs in a single playthrough.

guide.context: For the split-screen method, the Hermit is an Incubus so the character can cast Arcane Mark for one debuff, while player 2 is a Mechanist whose Beartraps add bleed and paralysis.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Hermit} and equip the @item{Shillelagh}.
Apply at least three debuffs to an enemy, using Arcane Mark, bleed, and paralysis together.
Land the killing blow with the Shillelagh while all three debuffs are still active, and repeat on 20 enemies.

achievements.description: Use Divine Zeal to kill 50 undead or demonic enemies in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 undead or demonic enemies with Divine Zeal during a single playthrough.

guide.context: Divine Zeal is a sustained Paladin spell, so keep it running while you fight. The Underworld, Haunted Castle, and Bram's Castle are full of undead.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Paladin} and cast @item{Divine Zeal}.
Kill undead and demonic enemies while the Divine Zeal effect is active, and keep fighting until 50 have fallen to it.

achievements.description: Parry 20 attacks in a row without taking any melee damage during your streak in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Parry 20 consecutive attacks in a single playthrough without taking melee damage at any point in the streak.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Paladin} and equip the @item{Claymore}.
Parry incoming melee attacks one after another until 20 consecutive parries are banked.
Avoid every melee hit while the streak is running; taking one resets the count to zero.

achievements.description: Deal 1000 damage with the rapier's riposte over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Cumulatively deal 1000 riposte damage with a Bard's rapier across multiple playthroughs.

guide.context: Hold the attack button so the rapier keeps heavy-attacking, then press the block key; keeping attack held stops the block press from triggering a Bard instrument.

steps.text: Play a @npc{Bard} wielding the rapier.
Hold the attack button, then press the block key to perform the rapier's riposte.
Riposte enemies repeatedly until the accumulated riposte damage reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Use Jewels to recruit allies 20 times as a True Gnome over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Recruit allies with Jewels 20 times as a true Gnome across multiple playthroughs.

guide.context: The Gnome-only Forge Jewel spell converts gems into Jewels. More valuable gems let you hire NPCs from deeper in the dungeon, and a Merchant appraises gems faster.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Gnome} and use @item{Forge Jewel} to turn gems into Jewels.
Give Jewels to NPCs to recruit them, and keep hiring until 20 recruits have been paid for with Jewels.

achievements.description: Use Germinate 50 times over multiple playthroughs as a True Dryad or Myconid.
achievements.summary: Cast Germinate 50 times as a true Dryad or Myconid across multiple playthroughs.

guide.context: Germinate spends a tier of Growth on each cast, so restarting runs at the spawn area is the quickest way to reach 50.

steps.text: Play a true @npc{Dryad} or @npc{Myconid}.
Cast @item{Germinate} repeatedly, restarting at the spawn area when Growth runs out, until 50 casts have been made.

achievements.description: Harvest 50 Myconid Mushrooms or Dryad Nuts using Germinate in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Grow 50 Myconid Mushrooms or Dryad Nuts with Germinate during a single playthrough.

steps.text: Play a true @npc{Dryad} or @npc{Myconid}.
Cast @item{Germinate}, let each plant expire, and collect the Mushrooms or Nuts it drops.
Recast Germinate after every level-up and keep harvesting until 50 forageables have been collected.

achievements.description: Prepare a meal that your character is unable to eat.
achievements.summary: As a true Skeleton, cook a meal your character cannot eat.

guide.context: A Skeleton cannot eat ordinary food, so any cooked ration counts as a meal it cannot eat.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Skeleton}.
Cook two different foods together in a frypan or at a cauldron to prepare a ration.

achievements.description: Wear a helmet that prevents your foliage from growing for at least 5 dungeon floors as a true Myconid.
achievements.summary: As a true Myconid, keep a foliage-blocking helmet equipped for five dungeon floors.

guide.context: Secret floors also count toward the five dungeon floors.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Myconid}.
Equip a helmet that stops the Myconid's foliage from growing.
Travel through at least five dungeon floors without removing the helmet.

achievements.description: Slay 20 enemies with Thorns damage as a True Dryad over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: As a true Dryad, kill 20 enemies with Thorns retaliation damage across multiple playthroughs.

guide.context: Thorns is a sustained Dryad spell that retaliates with magic damage whenever a melee attacker lands a hit on the caster.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Dryad} and sustain the @item{Thorns} spell.
Weaken an enemy to low health, then stand in melee range so Thorns retaliates and lands the killing damage.
Repeat until 20 enemies have died to Thorns.

achievements.description: Traverse 25 Dungeon floors and never lose your foliage as a True Dryad or Myconid.
achievements.summary: Cross 25 dungeon floors as a true Dryad or Myconid without losing your foliage.

guide.context: Germinate lowers Growth, and falling below one Growth removes the foliage, so stop casting in time to keep it.

steps.text: Play a true @npc{Dryad} or @npc{Myconid} and keep the foliage visible.
Never let Growth drop below one, since that loses the foliage and ruins the run's count.
Travel through 25 dungeon floors without losing the foliage.

achievements.description: Maintain Radiant status for 5 Dungeon Floors as a True Salamander.
achievements.summary: Stay in Radiant form for five dungeon floors as a true Salamander.

guide.context: Holding Radiant across full floors is easier later in a run, and secret floors count toward the five.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Salamander}.
Enter Radiant form and hold it while travelling through five dungeon floors.

achievements.description: Maintain Stony status for 10 Dungeon Floors as a True Salamander.
achievements.summary: Stay in Stony form for ten dungeon floors as a true Salamander.

guide.context: Reapply sanctuary whenever the form drops, and watch for mana regeneration from level-ups ending it.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Salamander}.
Enter Stony form and use sanctuary again whenever the form falls away.
Keep Stony status active through ten dungeon floors.

achievements.description: Complete 25 Dungeon Floors as a True Salamander without entering Radiant or Stone forms.
achievements.summary: As a true Salamander, finish 25 dungeon floors while never entering Radiant or Stony form.

guide.context: Casting spells can push a Salamander toward a form change, so cast as little as possible. Secret floors count toward the 25.

steps.text: Play as a true @npc{Salamander} and avoid entering Radiant or Stony form.
Travel through 25 dungeon floors without entering either form.

achievements.description: Gain Legendary skill in all three spell schools.
achievements.summary: Reach Legendary skill in Sorcery, Mysticism, and Thaumaturgy.

guide.context: Legendary is skill level 100. A Scion starts at 40 in all three schools, and a heavily cursed Sphinx's Casque raises Intelligence so higher-tier spells can be learned sooner.

steps.text: Play a @npc{Scion}, which begins with 40 in Sorcery, Mysticism, and Thaumaturgy.
Cast spells that show a gold plus icon, since those grant skill, and keep casting until each of the three schools reaches 100.

achievements.description: Use Fowl Spirit for 5 minutes in a single playthrough.
achievements.summary: Use Fowl Spirit for five minutes in a single playthrough.

guide.context: The Hermit's Project Spirit leaves the physical body behind, and the effect ends if that body takes harm.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Hermit} and cast @item{Project Spirit} to become a Fowl Spirit.
Stay in Fowl Spirit form and recast whenever the effect ends until five minutes have accumulated.

achievements.description: Lose your Fowl Spirit focus when an enemy strikes your abandoned body.
achievements.summary: Take a hit while projecting your spirit as a Hermit.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Hermit} and cast @item{Project Spirit}.
Draw an enemy to the abandoned body and let it land a hit while the Fowl Spirit is active.

achievements.description: Kill 50 Enemies using Booby Trap explosions over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with Booby Trap explosions across multiple playthroughs.

guide.context: A Sapper starts with the Booby Trap spell, which detonates a breakable object and damages everything in the blast.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Sapper} and cast @item{Booby Trap} on a breakable object.
Lure enemies beside the trapped object and let the explosion kill them.
Repeat until 50 enemies have died to Booby Trap blasts.

achievements.description: Spend 5000 gold required for magical effects over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Spend a lifetime total of 5000 gold on magical effects.

guide.context: The amount spent accumulates across every run.

steps.text: Pay gold whenever the game offers a magical effect for sale.
Keep buying magical effects across playthroughs until 5000 gold has been spent in total.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by rolling an Earth Sprite into them with Telekinesis.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with an Earth Sprite rolled into it using Telekinesis.

guide.context: The Scion starts with both Telekinesis and Summon Earth Sprite, and Telekinesis pulls boulders from a distance.

steps.text: Play a @npc{Scion} and cast @item{Summon Earth Sprite}.
Place an enemy in the sprite's path, then cast @item{Telekinesis} to pull and roll the sprite into the enemy for the kill.

achievements.description: Deflect 50 hits using Magicians' Bubble over multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Deflect 50 hits with Magicians' Bubble across multiple playthroughs.

guide.context: Magicians' Bubble grants invulnerability charges that are spent when an attack is negated; more Sorcery plus Intelligence raises the charge cap.

steps.text: Play as a @npc{Hermit} and cast @item{Magicians' Bubble}.
Take melee and projectile hits so the bubble negates them, then refresh the bubble.
Repeat until 50 hits have been deflected.

achievements.description: Prevent a lich from casting 10 spells at you using Null spells.
achievements.summary: Block ten lich spells with a Null Area field.

guide.context: Null Area is a Sorcery IV spell that destroys magical projectiles inside its field. Baron Herx and the twin bosses in the Sanctum both cast spells.

steps.text: Learn the @item{Null Area} spell, which is found most easily in the Mystic Library.
Cast Null Area and stand inside the field while a lich fires magic at you.
Stay in the field until ten lich spells have been destroyed.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with a Scion, plus a Wizard, Healer, or Arcanist.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in co-op with a Scion and a Wizard, Healer, or Arcanist.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the exit on floor 5. The Assist Shrine at the starting area can change a player's race or class.

steps.text: Start a cooperative game with at least two players.
Have one player be a @npc{Scion} and another be a @npc{Wizard}, @npc{Healer}, or @npc{Arcanist}.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with 3+ players where every character is short in their true race.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in a 3+ player co-op game where every character is short in its true race.

guide.context: Only the Dryad, Gremlin, Gnome, and Myconid races are short. The Assist Shrine at the starting area can change a player's race or class.

steps.text: Gather at least three players in a cooperative game.
Have every player use a true @npc{Dryad}, @npc{Gremlin}, @npc{Gnome}, or @npc{Myconid}.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with a Paladin, plus a Monk, Sexton, or Cleric.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in co-op with a Paladin and a Monk, Sexton, or Cleric.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the exit on floor 5. The Assist Shrine at the starting area can change a player's race or class.

steps.text: Start a cooperative game with at least two players.
Have one player be a @npc{Paladin} and another be a @npc{Monk}, @npc{Sexton}, or @npc{Cleric}.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with a Sapper, plus a Warrior, or Barbarian.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in co-op with a Sapper and a Warrior or Barbarian.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the exit on floor 5. The Assist Shrine at the starting area can change a player's race or class.

steps.text: Start a cooperative game with at least two players.
Have one player be a @npc{Sapper} and another be a @npc{Warrior} or @npc{Barbarian}.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with a Hermit, plus a Wanderer, or Ninja.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in co-op with a Hermit and a Wanderer or Ninja.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the exit on floor 5. The Assist Shrine at the starting area can change a player's race or class.

steps.text: Start a cooperative game with at least two players.
Have one player be a @npc{Hermit} and another be a @npc{Wanderer} or @npc{Ninja}.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with a Bard, plus a Merchant, Joker, or Rogue.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in co-op with a Bard and a Merchant, Joker, or Rogue.

guide.context: Escaping the Mines means reaching the exit on floor 5. The Assist Shrine at the starting area can change a player's race or class.

steps.text: Start a cooperative game with at least two players.
Have one player be a @npc{Bard} and another be a @npc{Merchant}, @npc{Joker}, or @npc{Rogue}.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with 3+ players with at least one race from each DLC.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in a 3+ player co-op game with a race from each DLC pack.

guide.context: The three DLC packs are Myths and Outcasts (Skeleton, Vampire, Succubus, Goatman), Legends and Pariahs (Automaton, Incubus, Goblin, Insectoid), and Deserters and Disciples (Gnome, Gremlin, Dryad, Myconid, Salamander).

steps.text: Gather at least three players in a cooperative game.
Have the party include one race from Myths and Outcasts, one from Legends and Pariahs, and one from Deserters and Disciples.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Escape the Mines in a cooperative game with 3+ players with at least one class from each DLC.
achievements.summary: Escape the Mines in a 3+ player co-op game with a class from each DLC pack.

guide.context: Myths and Outcasts classes are Conjurer, Accursed, Mesmer, and Brewer; Legends and Pariahs are Mechanist, Punisher, Shaman, and Hunter; Deserters and Disciples are Bard, Sapper, Scion, Hermit, and Paladin.

steps.text: Gather at least three players in a cooperative game.
Have the party include one class from Myths and Outcasts, one from Legends and Pariahs, and one from Deserters and Disciples.
Reach the Mines exit on floor 5 together.

achievements.description: Spend 1000 magic points using Sorcery Foci across multiple playthroughs.
achievements.summary: Spend 1000 magic points with Sorcery Foci across multiple playthroughs.

steps.text: Find a Sorcery Focus, an offhand magic item sold in staff shops.
Cast spells while the focus is equipped until 1000 magic points have been spent.

achievements.description: Escape the Citadel as a Bard of any race.
achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Bard of any race.

guide.context: Any race works for the class. The run must be finished through Act 2, which ends in the Sanctum on floor 35.

steps.text: Play any race as a @npc{Bard}.
Reach the Sanctum on floor 35 and defeat the final boss.

achievements.summary: Finish a run as a Paladin of any race.

achievements.summary: Escape the Citadel in your own true Salamander body, using any class.

guide.context: The character must be in its own Salamander body rather than a polymorph, and any class works. The run must be finished through Act 2, which ends in the Sanctum on floor 35.

steps.text: Play a true @npc{Salamander} of any class.
Reach the Sanctum on floor 35 and defeat the final boss.
